name: Pasta alla Genovese
blurb: Onions cooked down for hours with beef until sweet and jammy, stirred through pasta. Napoli's slow ragù.
method: Brown the beef, add the onions, carrot and celery and a splash of water.
Cook very low, stirring, for 3 hours until the onions collapse to a brown sauce and the beef shreds.
Add the wine near the end; toss with the pasta and Parmesan.

name: Tomato & Butter Spaghetti
blurb: Tinned tomatoes simmered with a whole onion and a lot of butter — Marcella's three-ingredient sauce.
method: Simmer the tomatoes, onion halves and butter very gently for 40 minutes, crushing the tomatoes.
Discard the onion (or eat it), season.
Toss with the spaghetti and serve with Parmesan.

name: Cavatelli with Cavolo Nero & Chilli
blurb: Little pasta dumplings with cavolo nero cooked soft in garlic, chilli and anchovy oil.
method: Boil the pasta, adding the cavolo nero for the last 5 minutes.
Melt the anchovies with the garlic and chilli in the oil.
Toss everything with pasta water and top with crunchy crumbs.

name: Creamy Sausage & Kale Gnocchi
blurb: Sausagemeat, kale and gnocchi in a fennel-scented cream. One pan, twenty-five minutes.
method: Fry the sausagemeat in chunks with the fennel and chilli until browned.
Add the gnocchi and a splash of water and cook 5 minutes.
Stir in the cream and kale, simmer to wilt, finish with Parmesan.

name: Tuna & Caper Fusilli
blurb: Store-cupboard tuna, capers, olives and tomato tossed with fusilli. A ten-minute win.
method: Fry the garlic, add the passata, olives and capers and simmer 8 minutes.
Flake in the tuna with its oil.
Toss with the fusilli and parsley.

name: Lemon Ricotta Spaghetti
blurb: Whipped ricotta loosened with pasta water and lemon into a light, creamy no-cook sauce.
method: Beat the ricotta with the lemon, Parmesan, oil and pepper.
Loosen with a few spoons of pasta water to a cream.
Toss the drained spaghetti through and finish with basil.

name: Rigatoni with Slow-Cooked Peppers
blurb: Peppers and onions stewed down for an hour into a sweet, silky sauce for rigatoni. Peperonata pasta.
method: Cook the peppers, onions and garlic in the oil, covered, on low for 45 minutes, then uncovered to jam down.
Add the vinegar and season.
Toss with the rigatoni and basil, and pasta water to loosen.

name: Sausage & Fennel Conchiglie
blurb: Shells that trap a rich sausage, fennel and tomato sauce with a hint of cream.
method: Fry the sausagemeat with the fennel bulb and seeds until browned.
Add the passata and simmer 12 minutes, then a splash of cream.
Toss with the shells and Parmesan.

name: Anchovy & Breadcrumb Spaghetti
blurb: Melted anchovy, garlic and chilli in oil, tossed with spaghetti and a shower of crunchy pangrattato.
method: Fry the breadcrumbs in some oil until golden, set aside.
Melt the anchovies with the garlic and chilli in more oil.
Toss the pasta through with pasta water and parsley, top with the crumbs.

name: Baked Tortellini Alfredo
blurb: Cheese tortellini folded into a quick Alfredo, topped with mozzarella and baked golden.
method: Make a béchamel with the butter, flour and milk, melt in the Parmesan and nutmeg.
Toss with the just-boiled tortellini, tip into a dish, top with mozzarella.
Bake at 200C for 18 minutes until bubbling; finish with parsley.

name: Pici Cacio e Pepe
blurb: Hand-rolled fat spaghetti with just pecorino, black pepper and starchy water. Tuscan minimalism.
method: Toast the pepper in a wide pan and add a ladle of pasta water.
Add the very al dente pasta with more water.
Off the heat, add the pecorino in handfuls, tossing hard until glossy.

name: Courgette Carbonara
blurb: Ribbons of courgette softened in oil stand in for guanciale in a lighter, greener carbonara.
method: Fry the courgettes in oil with the garlic until soft and lightly golden.
Whisk the yolks with the pecorino and pepper.
Toss the hot pasta with the courgettes, then the egg mix off the heat with pasta water.

name: Linguine with Walnut Sauce
blurb: A creamy Ligurian salsa di noci — blitzed walnuts, bread, garlic and milk — over linguine.
ingredients: 1 slice white bread, soaked in milk
method: Blitz the walnuts, squeezed bread, garlic, milk, Parmesan and oil to a loose paste.
Loosen with pasta water to a pourable sauce.
Toss with the linguine and a little more Parmesan.

name: Store-Cupboard Spaghetti Vongole
blurb: Tinned clams, garlic, chilli and white wine make a very fast vongole when fresh ones aren't around.
method: Fry the garlic and chilli in the oil, add the wine and clam liquor and reduce.
Add the clams to warm through.
Toss the pasta through with parsley and a little pasta water.

name: Buffalo Chicken Mac & Cheese
blurb: Shredded hot-sauce chicken folded into a blue-cheese-spiked mac and baked with a crumb.
method: Toss the chicken in the hot sauce.
Make a cheese sauce, fold in the pasta, chicken and blue cheese.
Top with crumbs and bake at 200C for 20 minutes.

name: One-Pan Tomato & Feta Orzo
blurb: Orzo cooked risotto-style in a tomato base, finished with feta and dill. Twenty-five minutes, one pan.
method: Soften the shallot, add the orzo and toast for a minute.
Add the passata and stock and simmer, stirring, for 12 minutes until creamy.
Crumble over the feta and dill.

name: White Bolognese Tagliatelle
blurb: A tomato-free ragù of pork, veal and wine, enriched with milk and Parmesan. Subtle and rich.
method: Soften the soffritto, add the mince and brown gently without colouring too hard.
Add the wine, then the milk and nutmeg and let it cook away, then the stock.
Simmer 1 hour, toss with the pasta and Parmesan.

name: Pasta con le Sarde
blurb: The Sicilian classic — sardines, wild fennel, raisins, pine nuts and saffron through bucatini.
method: Soften the onion and chopped fennel with the saffron, add most of the sardines and break down.
Stir in the raisins and pine nuts, then the drained pasta and some water.
Top with the reserved sardines, fennel fronds and crunchy crumbs.

name: Gnocchi with Pesto & Peas
blurb: Boiled gnocchi and peas tossed with basil pesto and a little butter. Fifteen minutes, kid-approved.
method: Boil the gnocchi, adding the peas for the last 2 minutes.
Drain, keeping a splash of water, and return to the pan.
Stir the pesto, butter and Parmesan through, loosen with the water.

name: Chorizo & Tomato Spaghetti
blurb: Smoky chorizo crisped in the pan, its red oil enriching a quick tomato sauce for spaghetti.
method: Fry the chorizo until the oil runs, add the garlic and paprika.
Add the tomatoes and simmer 10 minutes.
Toss with the spaghetti, pasta water and parsley.

name: Lemon & Asparagus Linguine
blurb: Snapped asparagus cooked in the pasta water, tossed with linguine, lemon, mint and Parmesan.
method: Cook the linguine, adding the asparagus for the last 3 minutes.
Drain, keeping water, and return to the pan with the oil, lemon and Parmesan.
Loosen with pasta water and finish with mint and pepper.

name: Pasta alla Norma Bake
blurb: Rigatoni baked in a tomato and fried-aubergine sauce with ricotta salata. A generous Sicilian dish.
method: Fry the aubergine in oil until golden, drain.
Simmer the tomatoes with the garlic and basil, fold in the aubergine and cooked pasta.
Tip into a dish, crumble over the cheese and bake at 190C for 20 minutes.

name: Pancetta, Pea & Egg Spaghetti
blurb: A carbonara-adjacent quick pasta with sweet peas folded through the silky egg sauce.
method: Crisp the pancetta; whisk the yolks with the Parmesan and pepper.
Cook the pasta, adding the peas for the last 2 minutes.
Toss the hot pasta and peas with the pancetta, then the egg mix off the heat with pasta water.

name: Lobster Mac & Cheese
blurb: Chunks of lobster folded into a Gruyère-and-cheddar mac, baked with a buttery crumb. A special-occasion bowl.
method: Make a béchamel, melt in the cheeses and Dijon.
Fold in the pasta and most of the lobster, tip into a dish, scatter the rest of the lobster and the panko.
Bake at 200C for 20 minutes; finish with chives.

name: Marmite Spaghetti
blurb: Nigella's cult supper — spaghetti tossed in butter melted with Marmite and a little pasta water.
method: Melt the butter with the Marmite and pasta water in the pan.
Add the drained spaghetti and toss until glossy.
Serve with Parmesan.

name: Mushroom & Chestnut Tagliatelle
blurb: A woodsy autumn pasta of chestnut mushrooms, crumbled chestnuts, thyme and a splash of cream.
method: Fry the mushrooms until golden, add the shallot, chestnuts and thyme.
Add the cream and simmer 3 minutes.
Toss the pasta through with Parmesan and pasta water.

name: Rigatoni Cacio e Pepe
blurb: Pecorino and cracked black pepper emulsified with starchy pasta water.
method: Toast the pepper in a wide pan for 30 seconds, add a ladle of pasta water.
Cook the pasta in minimal well-salted water until al dente.
Off the heat, toss the pasta with the pecorino and splashes of water to a creamy sauce.
Loosen as needed and serve at once.

name: Fettuccine Alfredo
blurb: Butter and Parmesan melted into pasta water for a glossy, cheesy coat.
method: Cook the pasta in well-salted water until al dente; save 2 mugs of water.
Melt the butter into a splash of pasta water in a wide pan.
Add the drained pasta and Parmesan, tossing hard with more water until glossy.
Season with pepper and nutmeg.

name: Penne alla Vodka
blurb: A silky tomato and cream sauce with a hit of vodka and chilli.
method: Fry the garlic and chilli in oil, add the purée and cook 2 minutes.
Add the vodka and let it bubble away, then stir in the cream.
Toss with the cooked penne, Parmesan and a little pasta water.
Finish with basil.

name: Garlic Prawn Linguine
blurb: Prawns, garlic, chilli, lemon and parsley — 15 minutes flat.
ingredients: 4 tbsp olive oil, handful of parsley
method: Cook the linguine until al dente.
Warm the oil, garlic and chilli, add the prawns and cook until pink.
Add the lemon zest and a splash of pasta water.
Toss the pasta through with the lemon juice and parsley.

name: Cajun Chicken Pasta
blurb: Spiced chicken and peppers in a creamy tomato-Parmesan sauce.
method: Toss the chicken in the Cajun seasoning and sear until browned.
Add the peppers and soften, then the passata and simmer 8 minutes.
Stir in the cream and Parmesan.
Toss with the cooked penne and a splash of pasta water.

name: Creamy Mushroom Tagliatelle
blurb: Golden-browned mushrooms, garlic, thyme, cream and Parmesan.
method: Fry the mushrooms in oil over high heat until deeply golden.
Add the garlic and thyme, then the wine and let it reduce.
Stir in the cream and Parmesan.
Toss with the pasta and pasta water; season with black pepper.

name: Tomato & Mascarpone Rigatoni
blurb: A quick tomato sauce enriched with a spoon of mascarpone.
method: Fry the garlic and purée, add the tomatoes and sugar and simmer 15 minutes.
Stir in the mascarpone until smooth.
Toss with the cooked rigatoni and pasta water.
Finish with basil and Parmesan.

name: Orecchiette with Broccoli & Anchovy
blurb: Soft broccoli, garlic, chilli and anchovy melted into the pasta.
method: Cook the pasta, adding the broccoli for the last 5 minutes until very soft.
Melt the anchovies with the garlic and chilli in the oil.
Drain the pasta and broccoli and toss through the anchovy oil, crushing some broccoli.
Loosen with pasta water and finish with Parmesan.

name: Baked Feta Pasta
blurb: A block of feta roasted with cherry tomatoes, then stirred into pasta.
method: Put the feta in the middle of a dish, surround with tomatoes, garlic, chilli and oil.
Bake at 200C fan for 30 minutes until the tomatoes burst and feta softens.
Cook the pasta.
Mash the feta and tomatoes together, then toss with the pasta and basil.

name: Pesto Chicken Gnocchi
blurb: Pan-crisped gnocchi with chicken, spinach and pesto.
method: Sear the chicken in a wide pan until golden and cooked; set aside.
Fry the gnocchi in the same pan until crisp and golden.
Return the chicken, add the spinach and let it wilt.
Off the heat, stir through the pesto (and cream) and a splash of water; top with Parmesan.

name: Sausage & Kale Orecchiette
blurb: Craggy fried sausage meat, garlic, chilli and kale on ear-shaped pasta.
ingredients: 1 tsp fennel seeds, 1/2 tsp chilli flakes
method: Fry the sausage meat hard until deeply browned and craggy.
Add the fennel, chilli and garlic, then the kale with a splash of water until wilted.
Toss with the cooked pasta and pasta water.
Finish with Parmesan.

name: Lemon & Ricotta Spaghetti
blurb: Ricotta loosened with pasta water, lemon zest, basil and Parmesan.
method: Cook the spaghetti until al dente; save a mug of water.
Beat the ricotta with the lemon zest, oil and a few tbsp pasta water.
Toss the pasta through with the lemon juice and Parmesan.
Finish with basil and black pepper.

name: Spring Carbonara with Peas
blurb: Classic egg-and-pecorino carbonara brightened with fresh peas.
method: Boil the pasta, adding the peas for the last 2 minutes.
Fry the pancetta until crisp.
Beat the eggs with the pecorino and lots of pepper.
Off the heat, toss the drained pasta and peas with the pancetta, then the egg mix and splashes of water to a glossy sauce.

name: 'Nduja Rigatoni
blurb: Spicy spreadable sausage melted into a rich tomato sauce.
method: Fry the garlic, add the 'nduja and let it melt into the oil.
Add the purée and tomatoes and simmer 15 minutes.
Toss with the cooked rigatoni, Parmesan and pasta water.
Finish with basil.

name: Tuna Arrabbiata
blurb: Fiery tomato and chilli sauce with good tinned tuna.
method: Fry the garlic and chilli in a little of the tuna oil.
Add the tomatoes and a pinch of salt and simmer 12 minutes.
Flake in the tuna and warm through.
Toss with the cooked penne and parsley.

name: Butternut & Sage Pasta
blurb: Roast squash blitzed into a silky sauce with brown butter and sage.
method: Roast the squash with oil at 200C fan for 30 minutes until soft.
Blitz with the garlic, nutmeg and enough pasta water to a smooth sauce.
Fry the sage in the butter until crisp and the butter smells nutty.
Toss the pasta with the squash sauce, then top with the sage butter and Parmesan.

name: Baked Spinach & Ricotta Shells
blurb: Giant pasta shells stuffed with spinach ricotta, baked in tomato sauce.
method: Cook the shells 2 minutes under and drain.
Mix the ricotta, spinach, egg, Parmesan and nutmeg; season.
Spread garlicky passata in a dish, stuff and arrange the shells, cover with more passata and the mozzarella.
Bake at 190C fan for 25-30 minutes until bubbling.

name: Chicken Pesto Pasta
blurb: Fusilli, griddled chicken, cherry tomatoes and stirred-through basil pesto.
method: Season and griddle the chicken, then rest and slice.
Cook the pasta; save a mug of water.
Toss the pasta with the pesto, tomatoes and a splash of water.
Fold through the chicken and rocket; top with Parmesan.

name: Stovetop Mac & Cheese
blurb: A quick, creamy no-bake mac and cheese for a weeknight.
method: Cook the macaroni.
Make a roux with butter and flour, whisk in the milk and simmer to a smooth sauce.
Off the heat stir in the cheese, mustard and nutmeg.
Fold in the pasta and loosen with a little milk; serve straight away.

name: Bucatini Puttanesca
blurb: Olives, capers, anchovy, garlic and chilli in a punchy tomato sauce.
method: Melt the anchovies with the garlic and chilli in olive oil.
Add the olives, capers and tomatoes and simmer 15 minutes.
Toss with the cooked bucatini and pasta water.
Finish with parsley.

name: Pasta Primavera
blurb: Spring vegetables — asparagus, peas, courgette — in a light lemony sauce.
method: Cook the pasta, adding the chopped vegetables for the last 3 minutes.
Warm the oil and garlic in a wide pan.
Toss the drained pasta and veg through with the lemon and a splash of pasta water.
Finish with Parmesan and mint.

name: Quick Beef Ragù Pappardelle
blurb: A fast weeknight ragù of beef mince, soffritto, wine and tomato.
ingredients: 1 onion, 1 carrot, 1 celery stick, finely diced
2 tbsp tomato purée, 400g tin chopped tomatoes
method: Soften the soffritto for 8 minutes, then brown the mince.
Add the purée, then the wine and let it reduce.
Add the tomatoes and a splash of water and simmer 25 minutes.
Toss with the pappardelle and pasta water; serve with Parmesan.

name: Chilli Crab Linguine
blurb: White and brown crab meat with garlic, chilli, lemon and parsley.
ingredients: 4 tbsp olive oil, handful of parsley
method: Cook the linguine until al dente.
Warm the oil, garlic and chilli, then stir in the brown crab meat and a splash of pasta water.
Toss the pasta through with the white crab, lemon and parsley.
Serve immediately with black pepper.

name: Classic Roast Chicken
blurb: A butter-basted whole chicken with lemon and thyme, roast potatoes and gravy. The family Sunday.
method: Rub the chicken with butter, put the lemon and thyme inside, roast at 200C for 1 hour 20, basting.
Parboil and roughen the potatoes, roast in hot fat for 50 minutes until crisp.
Rest the bird; make gravy in the tin with flour, stock and the juices.

name: Roast Beef & Yorkshire Puddings
blurb: A pink rib of beef with towering Yorkshires, horseradish and red wine gravy. A proper occasion.
method: Sear the beef, then roast at 190C to your liking (about 15 min per 500g for medium-rare); rest 30 minutes.
Get the dripping smoking-hot in the tins, pour in the rested batter and bake at 220C for 25 minutes.
Make gravy with the wine and stock in the roasting tin.

name: Slow-Roast Shoulder of Lamb
blurb: Lamb shoulder cooked for five hours with garlic and rosemary until it pulls apart with a spoon.
method: Sit the lamb on the sliced potatoes and onions, add the wine and stock, tuck in garlic and rosemary.
Cover tightly and cook at 150C for 4.5 hours, then uncover and turn up to 200C for 30 minutes.
Rest, then shred and serve with the potatoes that have cooked in the juices.

name: Roast Pork Loin with Crackling
blurb: A loin scored and salted for shattering crackling, with apple sauce and roast potatoes.
method: Rub the skin with oil and salt, blast at 240C for 30 minutes, then drop to 180C for 1 hour.
Stew the apples with a splash of water and the sugar to a sauce.
Roast the potatoes; rest the pork and make cider gravy in the tin.

name: Harissa Chicken Traybake
blurb: Chicken thighs roasted with chickpeas, peppers and red onion in a rose-harissa glaze. One tray, feeds four.
method: Toss everything with the harissa, oil and seasoning in a big roasting tin.
Roast at 200C for 40 minutes, turning once, until the chicken is crisp and cooked.
Squeeze over lemon and serve with yoghurt.

name: Sausage, Apple & Red Onion Traybake
blurb: Sausages roasted with wedges of apple, red onion and new potatoes in a sticky balsamic glaze.
method: Parboil the potatoes 8 minutes, drain.
Toss everything in the oil and balsamic in a roasting tin.
Roast at 200C for 35 minutes, turning halfway, until browned and sticky.

name: Salmon & Greens Traybake
blurb: Salmon fillets roasted over tenderstem, cherry tomatoes and potatoes with lemon and dill.
method: Roast the potatoes in oil at 200C for 20 minutes.
Add the broccoli and tomatoes, sit the salmon on top, season and add lemon slices.
Roast 12-14 minutes more until the salmon just flakes; scatter with dill.

name: Roast Veg & Halloumi Traybake
blurb: A tray of roasted Mediterranean veg with chunks of halloumi that go golden at the edges.
method: Toss the chopped veg with oil and oregano and roast at 210C for 20 minutes.
Add the tomatoes and halloumi and roast 15 minutes more until everything is coloured.
Finish with lemon and basil.

name: Gochujang Chicken & Sweet Potato Traybake
blurb: Sticky, spicy Korean-style chicken thighs roasted with sweet potato wedges and spring onion.
method: Toss the sweet potato in sesame oil and roast at 200C for 15 minutes.
Coat the chicken in the gochujang, honey and soy, add to the tray and roast 30 minutes.
Scatter with spring onions and sesame seeds.

name: Porchetta-Style Rolled Pork
blurb: Pork belly rolled around a fennel, garlic and herb stuffing, roasted until the skin blisters.
ingredients: 2 tbsp fennel seeds, toasted and ground
method: Blitz the fennel, garlic, zest, herbs and some salt to a paste, spread over the flesh side.
Roll tightly and tie, salt the skin, roast at 220C for 40 minutes then 160C for 2 hours.
Blast again at 240C to crisp the skin, rest 20 minutes, carve into thick slices.

name: Whole Roast Cauliflower
blurb: A cauliflower steamed then roasted whole under a spiced yoghurt crust, carved at the table.
ingredients: pomegranate seeds and herbs to finish
method: Steam the whole cauliflower for 12 minutes until a knife slips in with slight resistance.
Mix the yoghurt, oil, spices and lemon and coat the cauliflower all over.
Roast at 200C for 40-45 minutes until deep golden; scatter with pomegranate and herbs.

name: Slow-Roast Duck Legs with Orange
blurb: Duck legs roasted low until the fat renders and the meat falls off, in a sharp orange sauce.
ingredients: 800g potatoes for roasting in the duck fat
method: Salt the duck legs and roast at 150C for 2 hours until tender, pouring off the fat (keep it for the potatoes).
Simmer the orange juice, zest, honey, stock and vinegar to a glossy sauce.
Crisp the legs at 200C for 15 minutes, roast the potatoes in the reserved fat, and spoon over the sauce.

name: Mushroom & Chestnut Nut Roast
blurb: A properly savoury nut roast with mushrooms, chestnuts and thyme, for the veggie centrepiece.
method: Fry the onions and mushrooms until dry, mix with the nuts, chestnuts, breadcrumbs, cheese, herbs and eggs.
Press firmly into a lined loaf tin.
Bake at 180C for 45 minutes until firm and golden; rest before slicing.

name: Jerk Chicken Traybake with Rice & Peas
blurb: Marinated jerk thighs roasted over coconut rice and kidney beans. One tin of Caribbean sunshine.
method: Coat the chicken in the jerk marinade, ideally overnight.
Stir the rice, coconut milk, stock, beans, thyme and spring onions into a deep tin, sit the chicken on top.
Cover with foil, bake at 190C for 30 minutes, then uncover for 20 to crisp the skin.

name: Salmon en Croûte
blurb: A side of salmon with spinach and cream cheese wrapped in golden puff pastry. A dinner-party showstopper.
method: Mix the spinach, cream cheese, zest and dill and spread over one piece of pastry, sit the salmon on top.
Cover with the second pastry sheet, seal and crimp, glaze with egg and score.
Bake at 200C for 30-35 minutes until deep golden; rest 10 minutes before slicing.

name: Rice-Stuffed Roast Peppers
blurb: Peppers baked full of herby tomato rice and feta until soft and slightly charred.
method: Fry the onion, add the tomatoes and reduce, then stir through the rice and herbs.
Fill the pepper halves, crumble feta on top and drizzle with oil.
Bake at 190C for 40 minutes until the peppers are tender and blistered.

name: Maple-Glazed Roast Gammon
blurb: A gammon joint simmered then roasted under a maple-mustard glaze, sliced hot or cold.
method: Simmer the gammon with the onion, bay and cloves for 1 hour 40, then drain.
Score the fat, stud with cloves, brush with the mixed maple, mustard and sugar.
Roast at 200C for 25 minutes, basting, until burnished.

name: Chicken Shawarma Traybake
blurb: Spiced, lemony chicken thighs roasted with onions, then piled into flatbreads with garlic sauce.
ingredients: garlic sauce, pickles and salad to serve
method: Marinate the chicken in the spice, lemon juice and oil for an hour.
Spread with the onions in a tin and roast at 210C for 35 minutes, then slice.
Serve in warm flatbreads with garlic sauce, pickles and salad.

name: Roasted Vegetable Toad in the Hole
blurb: Chunks of squash, red onion and courgette baked into Yorkshire batter with an onion gravy.
method: Roast the veg in the oil in a hot tin at 220C for 20 minutes.
Pour the rested batter over the sizzling veg and bake 30 minutes without opening the door.
Serve with dark onion gravy.

name: Baked Camembert with Roast Potatoes
blurb: A whole cheese baked molten with garlic and rosemary, for dunking crispy potatoes and bread.
method: Roast the halved potatoes in oil at 200C for 35 minutes until crisp.
Score the cheese, stud with garlic and rosemary, drizzle with honey and bake for the last 15 minutes.
Serve the melting cheese in the middle of the potatoes to dip.

name: Herb-Crusted Rack of Lamb
blurb: A rack of lamb seared and roasted pink under a parsley, garlic and breadcrumb crust.
method: Sear the lamb all over in a hot pan, then brush the fat side with mustard.
Blitz the breadcrumbs, parsley, garlic and butter and press onto the mustard.
Roast at 200C for 18-20 minutes for pink, rest 10 minutes, carve into cutlets.

name: Roast Squash, Halloumi & Grain Traybake
blurb: Butternut and red onion roasted with halloumi, tipped into lemony grains with pomegranate.
method: Roast the squash and onion in oil at 210C for 25 minutes.
Add the halloumi and roast 12 minutes more.
Fold through the warm grains, lemon, pomegranate and parsley.

name: Roast Turkey Crown with Gravy
blurb: A butter-and-herb basted turkey crown that stays moist, with a proper roasting-tin gravy.
method: Push herb butter under the skin, sit the crown on the veg, roast at 190C for about 2 hours to 65C internal.
Rest, covered, for 30 minutes.
Make gravy in the tin with the flour, wine and stock, scraping up the sticky bits.

name: Cod, Chorizo & Butter Bean Traybake
blurb: Cod loins roasted over smoky chorizo, butter beans and cherry tomatoes. Fifteen minutes' work.
method: Roast the chorizo, beans, tomatoes, onion and oil at 200C for 15 minutes.
Nestle in the cod, season, and roast 10-12 minutes more until it flakes.
Scatter with parsley.

name: Beef Wellington
blurb: Fillet of beef with mushroom duxelles and prosciutto in burnished puff pastry. The special-occasion centrepiece.
method: Sear the seasoned fillet hard on all sides, cool, then brush with mustard.
Fry the mushrooms until completely dry, cool, spread over overlapping prosciutto on cling film, wrap the beef and chill.
Encase in pastry, glaze, score, and bake at 200C for 35-40 minutes to 50C internal; rest 15 minutes before slicing.

name: Chicken with Forty Cloves of Garlic
blurb: A whole chicken pot-roasted with a heap of unpeeled garlic that turns sweet and spreadable.
method: Brown the chicken in butter in a casserole, add the garlic, wine, stock and thyme.
Cover and cook at 180C for 1 hour 20, basting once.
Serve with the soft garlic squeezed onto toasted baguette and the pan juices.

name: Aubergine Parmigiana
blurb: Layers of fried aubergine, rich tomato sauce and mozzarella baked until molten. A generous veggie bake.
method: Salt the aubergine slices, pat dry and fry in oil until golden.
Simmer the tomatoes with the garlic and basil to a thick sauce.
Layer sauce, aubergine, mozzarella and Parmesan three times and bake at 190C for 35 minutes.

name: Whole Sea Bass with Fennel & Potatoes
blurb: Two whole sea bass roasted over sliced fennel, potatoes and lemon. A quietly impressive tray.
ingredients: 2 whole sea bass, gutted and scaled
method: Roast the potatoes and fennel in oil at 200C for 25 minutes.
Slash the fish, stuff with lemon and parsley, sit on the veg, add the wine.
Roast 20 minutes more until the fish is cooked through.

name: Roast Pork Tenderloin with Mustard Cream
blurb: A quick-roasting fillet of pork, sliced into a mustard and crème fraîche pan sauce.
method: Sear the seasoned tenderloins all over, then roast at 200C for 15 minutes; rest.
Soften the shallot in the pan, add the wine and reduce, then the crème fraîche and mustard.
Slice the pork and serve in the sauce with mash.

name: Roasted Vegetable & Goat's Cheese Tart
blurb: A puff-pastry tart topped with roast peppers, courgette, red onion and blobs of goat's cheese.
method: Roast the sliced veg in oil at 210C for 20 minutes.
Score a border on the pastry, spread the middle with pesto, top with veg and goat's cheese, glaze the edge.
Bake at 200C for 22 minutes until puffed and golden; top with rocket.

name: Greek Lemon Chicken & Potatoes
blurb: Chicken thighs and potato wedges roasted in lemon, oregano and stock until sticky and soft.
method: Toss everything in a big tin with the oil, oregano, lemon juice, garlic and stock.
Roast at 200C for 50-60 minutes, turning the potatoes once, until the chicken is crisp and the stock is nearly gone.

name: Baked Gnocchi with Tomato & Mozzarella
blurb: Gnocchi tipped straight into a tin with tomato sauce and mozzarella and baked bubbling.
method: Simmer the tomatoes with the garlic and oregano for 10 minutes.
Stir in the raw gnocchi, tip into a dish, tear over the mozzarella and scatter Parmesan.
Bake at 200C for 20 minutes until golden and bubbling; finish with basil.

name: Roast Monkfish Wrapped in Parma Ham
blurb: A monkfish tail wrapped in Parma ham and roasted, carved into thick medallions. Dinner-party fish.
method: Wrap the seasoned monkfish in overlapping ham with rosemary tucked in.
Sear in oil, then roast at 200C for 18-20 minutes.
Rest, slice thickly, and spoon over the butter melted with lemon and capers.

name: Mixed Sausage & Onion Tray Roast
blurb: A tray of different sausages roasted with red onions, garlic and grapes until jammy. Serve with mash.
method: Toss everything but the mash in a tin with the oil, balsamic and thyme.
Roast at 200C for 35-40 minutes, turning once, until the sausages are browned and the grapes have burst.
Serve over mashed potato with the pan juices.

name: Baked Cod with a Herb & Lemon Crumb
blurb: Cod fillets under a crisp parsley-lemon breadcrumb, baked in ten minutes on a bed of spinach.
method: Wilt the spinach in the oil and spread in a baking dish, sit the cod on top.
Mix the crumbs, parsley, zest and butter and press onto the fish.
Bake at 200C for 12-14 minutes until the crumb is golden and the fish flakes.

name: Roasted Roots & Giant Couscous Tray
blurb: Carrots, parsnip and beetroot roasted with cumin, then stirred through giant couscous with feta.
method: Roast the roots with the cumin and oil at 210C for 35 minutes.
Cook the giant couscous in stock until tender, drain.
Fold the roots through with lemon, dill and crumbled feta.

name: Braised Lamb Shanks in Red Wine
blurb: Shanks slow-braised until the meat slides off the bone, in a glossy rosemary-red wine sauce.
method: Dust and brown the shanks, remove, soften the diced veg.
Add the wine and reduce by half, then the tomatoes, stock and rosemary and return the shanks.
Cover and cook at 160C for 2.5 hours, then reduce the sauce on the hob. Serve on mash.

name: Spanish Chicken & Chorizo Traybake
blurb: Chicken thighs roasted with chorizo, new potatoes, peppers and smoked paprika until everything's stained red.
method: Parboil the potatoes 8 minutes.
Toss everything with the paprika, oil and seasoning in a big tin.
Roast at 200C for 40 minutes, turning once, until the chicken is crisp and the chorizo oil coats the potatoes.

name: Hasselback Potato & Sausage Traybake
blurb: Fanned potatoes roasted alongside sausages and cherry tomatoes with garlic butter.
method: Roast the potatoes in oil at 200C for 30 minutes.
Add the sausages and tomatoes, brush the potatoes with the garlic-thyme butter.
Roast 30 minutes more, basting once, until crisp.

name: Roast Chicken with Tarragon Butter
blurb: A whole chicken roasted with tarragon-lemon butter under the skin, in a white-wine pan sauce.
method: Mash the butter with the tarragon and zest, push under the skin and over the breast.
Roast at 200C for 1 hour 20, basting, then rest.
Deglaze the tin with the wine, add the stock and cream and reduce to a sauce.

name: Mushroom & Spinach Wellington
blurb: A log of garlicky mushrooms, spinach and chestnuts wrapped in puff pastry — the veggie centrepiece.
method: Fry the onion, garlic and mushrooms until completely dry, add the chestnuts, spinach and thyme, then bind with breadcrumbs; cool.
Shape into a firm log on the pastry, wrap, seal and glaze, and score the top.
Bake at 200C for 35-40 minutes until deep golden; rest before slicing.

name: Roast Cod on Puy Lentils
blurb: A thick cod loin roasted and set on braised puy lentils with bacon and a lemon-parsley dressing.
method: Fry the lardons and diced veg, add the lentils and stock and simmer 25 minutes until tender.
Sear the cod skin-side down, then roast at 200C for 8-10 minutes.
Sit the cod on the lentils and spoon over lemon-parsley oil.

name: Whole Stuffed Roast Squash
blurb: Halves of squash roasted and filled with spiced grains, feta and pomegranate, back in the oven to warm.
method: Rub the squash with oil, roast cut-side down at 200C for 35 minutes until soft.
Mix the grains with the baharat, herbs, feta, pomegranate and pine nuts.
Fill the squash halves and return to the oven for 10 minutes.

name: Sticky Oven Pork Ribs
blurb: Racks of ribs cooked low under foil then glazed with a smoky-sweet barbecue sauce and blasted hot.
method: Rub the ribs with the paprika, sugar and garlic, wrap in foil and bake at 150C for 2.5 hours.
Simmer the ketchup, vinegar, molasses and Worcestershire to a glaze.
Unwrap the ribs, brush with glaze and roast at 220C for 15 minutes, glazing twice more.

name: Roasted Veg & Baked Feta Tray
blurb: A block of feta roasted in the middle of honeyed cherry tomatoes, courgette and peppers, for piling on bread.
method: Scatter the chopped veg in a tin, sit the feta in the middle, drizzle with oil, honey and oregano.
Roast at 200C for 30 minutes until the veg are soft and the feta is bronzed.
Crush together loosely and scoop up with bread.

name: Pot-Roast Guinea Fowl with Bacon
blurb: A whole guinea fowl braised with bacon, shallots and cider — a step up from the Sunday chicken.
method: Brown the bird in a casserole, remove, fry the bacon and shallots.
Return the bird with the cider, stock, thyme and potatoes, cover and cook at 180C for 1 hour.
Rest the fowl; reduce the sauce with the cream.

name: Crispy Tofu & Broccoli Traybake
blurb: Cornflour-dusted tofu roasted with broccoli and a soy-maple-sesame glaze until sticky. Vegan, one tray.
method: Toss the tofu in the cornflour and 2 tbsp sesame oil, roast at 220C for 20 minutes.
Add the broccoli and roast 12 minutes.
Pour over the mixed soy, maple, vinegar and chilli and roast 5 minutes more; serve with rice.

name: Crispy Fish Tacos
blurb: Beer-battered white fish, lime slaw and chipotle crema in soft tortillas.
ingredients: 120g flour, 1 tsp baking powder, 180ml cold beer or sparkling water, 1 tsp paprika
1/4 white cabbage, shredded with lime and coriander
Crema: 4 tbsp soured cream, 2 tbsp mayo, 1 tbsp chipotle, lime
method: Whisk the flour, baking powder, paprika and beer to a thin batter.
Dip the fish and fry at 180C for 3-4 minutes until crisp; drain.
Toss the cabbage with lime, salt and coriander; mix the crema.
Fill warm tortillas with slaw, fish and crema.

name: Mussels in Cider & Cream
blurb: Mussels steamed open in cider with leeks, cream and lots of parsley.
method: Discard any open mussels that don't close when tapped.
Soften the leeks and garlic in the butter.
Add the cider, bring to the boil, tip in the mussels and cover.
Steam 3-4 minutes until open; stir in the cream and parsley and serve with bread.

name: Sticky Teriyaki Salmon
blurb: Salmon fillets glazed in a sweet-savoury teriyaki, with rice and greens.
ingredients: Sauce: 5 tbsp soy, 4 tbsp mirin, 3 tbsp sake, 2 tbsp sugar, 1 tsp grated ginger
Rice and steamed pak choi to serve
method: Sear the salmon skin-side down until crisp, then flip.
Add the sauce and let it bubble and reduce, spooning over the salmon until glossy.
Serve over rice with greens.
Finish with sesame and spring onions.

name: Prawn & Lemon Risotto
blurb: Creamy risotto finished with garlicky prawns, lemon and parsley.
ingredients: 150ml white wine, 1.2 litres hot fish stock
method: Soften the onion, add half the garlic, then the rice for 2 minutes.
Add the wine, then the stock a ladle at a time, stirring, for 18 minutes.
Meanwhile fry the prawns with the rest of the garlic until pink.
Beat the butter and lemon into the risotto, then fold in the prawns and parsley.

name: Herb-Crusted Cod with Crushed Potatoes
blurb: Cod with a parsley-lemon breadcrumb crust and buttery crushed new potatoes.
ingredients: 80g breadcrumbs, big handful of parsley, zest of 1 lemon, 40g melted butter
method: Boil the potatoes until tender, then lightly crush with butter and chives.
Blitz the breadcrumbs with the parsley, lemon zest and butter.
Press the crust onto the seasoned cod and bake at 200C fan for 12-15 minutes.
Serve with the crushed potatoes and greens.

name: Thai Fishcakes with Sweet Chilli
blurb: Bouncy red-curry fishcakes with green beans and a sweet chilli-cucumber dip.
ingredients: 2 tbsp red curry paste, 1 tbsp fish sauce, 1 egg, 1 tsp sugar
Sweet chilli sauce with diced cucumber and peanuts
method: Blitz the fish with the curry paste, fish sauce, egg and sugar to a sticky paste.
Fold in the beans and lime leaves.
Shape into small patties and fry for 2-3 minutes each side until golden and springy.
Serve with the cucumber sweet chilli dip.

name: Seafood Linguine (Frutti di Mare)
blurb: Prawns, mussels, clams and squid in a light garlic-chilli-tomato sauce.
method: Cook the linguine until just shy of al dente.
Fry the garlic and chilli, add the wine and mussels/clams, cover until they open.
Add the tomatoes and simmer 5 minutes, then the prawns and squid for 2-3 minutes.
Toss the pasta through with parsley, lemon and a little pasta water.

name: Fish Pie Jacket Potatoes
blurb: Baked potatoes loaded with a quick creamy smoked fish and pea filling.
ingredients: 400g smoked haddock or salmon, poached and flaked
method: Bake the pricked, oiled and salted potatoes at 200C fan for 70-80 minutes.
Make a white sauce with butter, cornflour and milk; stir in the herbs, peas and flaked fish.
Split and fluff the potatoes and pile in the filling.
Top with cheese and grill for 5 minutes.

name: Prawn Toast Noodles
blurb: Sesame prawn toasts alongside a quick garlic-soy noodle stir-fry.
ingredients: 300g raw prawns, blitzed with 1 egg white, 1 tsp sesame oil, 1 tsp cornflour, 2 spring onions
Sauce: 3 tbsp soy, 1 tbsp oyster sauce, 1 tsp sugar, 1 tsp chilli oil
method: Spread the prawn paste on the bread, press into sesame seeds, and fry paste-side down until golden; flip briefly.
Cut into triangles.
Stir-fry the garlic and pak choi, add the noodles and sauce and toss.
Serve the noodles with the prawn toasts on top.

name: Seared Tuna with Warm Niçoise Potatoes
blurb: Rare tuna over warm crushed potatoes, beans, olives and a mustard dressing.
ingredients: Dressing: 5 tbsp olive oil, 2 tbsp red wine vinegar, 1 tsp Dijon, 1 garlic clove
method: Boil the potatoes and beans; drain and lightly crush the potatoes.
Toss the warm potatoes and beans with the dressing, olives and capers.
Sear the seasoned tuna for 1 minute each side so it stays rare inside.
Slice the tuna over the warm salad; scatter with parsley.

name: Smoked Haddock & Sweetcorn Chowder
blurb: A creamy potato chowder with smoked haddock, sweetcorn and bacon.
method: Fry the bacon until crisp, then soften the onion and celery in the fat.
Add the potatoes and stock and simmer until nearly tender.
Add the milk (thickened with the cornflour), sweetcorn and haddock, and simmer 5 minutes.
Finish with the herbs and lots of black pepper.

name: Salmon en Croûte
blurb: Salmon fillet with dill cream cheese and spinach, baked in puff pastry.
ingredients: 150g cream cheese, big handful of dill, zest of 1 lemon
New potatoes and greens to serve
method: Mix the cream cheese with the dill and lemon zest.
Lay the pastry out, spread with the spinach then the cream cheese, and sit the salmon on top.
Wrap tightly, seal, score the top and glaze with egg.
Bake at 200C fan for 25-30 minutes until deep golden; rest 5 minutes.

name: Bengali Fish Curry (Machher Jhol)
blurb: White fish in a light, mustardy turmeric broth with potato.
ingredients: 600g firm white fish, in pieces, rubbed with turmeric and salt
1 tsp turmeric, 1 tsp cumin, 1 tsp chilli powder
method: Lightly fry the turmeric-rubbed fish; set aside.
Pop the mustard and nigella seeds in the oil, add the potatoes and fry 5 minutes.
Add the ground spices, tomatoes and 500ml water and simmer until the potatoes are tender.
Slip the fish back in with the green chillies and poach 5 minutes; finish with coriander.

name: Crab Cakes with Lime Mayo
blurb: Delicate crab cakes with spring onion and chilli, pan-fried golden.
ingredients: 80g breadcrumbs, 1 egg, 3 tbsp mayo, 1 tsp Dijon
3 spring onions, 1 red chilli, zest of 1 lime, handful of parsley
Extra breadcrumbs for coating, oil for frying
Lime mayo: 4 tbsp mayo, juice of 1 lime, pinch of cayenne
method: Mix the crab with the breadcrumbs, egg, mayo, mustard, spring onions, chilli, lime zest and parsley.
Shape into 8 cakes, coat in breadcrumbs and chill 20 minutes.
Fry for 3 minutes each side until deep golden.
Serve with lime mayo and a green salad.

name: Pesto-Baked Salmon Traybake
blurb: Salmon under a pesto crust with cherry tomatoes and new potatoes.
method: Toss the potatoes with oil and roast at 200C fan for 20 minutes.
Add the tomatoes and sit the salmon among them.
Mix the pesto, breadcrumbs and Parmesan and spoon onto the salmon.
Roast 12-15 minutes until the crust is golden; serve with rocket.

name: Prawn Laksa
blurb: Rice noodles in a coconut-curry broth with prawns, tofu puffs and beansprouts.
ingredients: 400ml coconut milk, 700ml fish or chicken stock
2 tsp fish sauce, juice of 1 lime
method: Fry the laksa paste in a little coconut cream until fragrant.
Add the rest of the coconut milk and the stock and simmer 5 minutes.
Add the prawns and tofu puffs and cook 3-4 minutes; season with fish sauce and lime.
Divide the cooked noodles and beansprouts between bowls, ladle over the laksa, and top with coriander, shallots and chilli.

name: Fish Goujons with Chips & Peas
blurb: Homemade breaded fish strips, oven chips and minted crushed peas.
ingredients: 300g frozen peas, knob of butter, handful of mint
method: Roast the chips at 220C fan for 30-35 minutes.
Coat the fish in flour, egg then panko.
Shallow fry for 2-3 minutes each side until golden; drain.
Crush the cooked peas with butter and mint; serve with the goujons, chips and tartare.

name: Warm Salmon & Rice Poke Bowl
blurb: Flaked seared salmon over rice with edamame, avocado, cucumber and a soy dressing.
ingredients: Dressing: 3 tbsp soy, 1 tbsp rice vinegar, 1 tsp sesame oil, 1 tsp honey, 1 tsp sriracha
method: Cook the rice.
Sear the salmon and flake into big pieces.
Whisk the dressing.
Build bowls with rice, salmon, edamame, avocado and cucumber; drizzle with the dressing and top with ginger, sesame and spring onions.

name: Linguine alle Vongole
blurb: Clams opened in white wine and garlic, tossed through linguine with chilli and parsley.
ingredients: 4 garlic cloves, sliced, 1/2 tsp chilli flakes
4 tbsp olive oil, big handful of parsley
method: Cook the linguine until just shy of al dente.
Warm the oil, garlic and chilli, add the clams and wine, and cover.
Steam 3-4 minutes until they open, discarding any that stay shut.
Add the pasta and parsley with a splash of pasta water and toss until glossy.

name: Whole Baked Fish with Lemon Butter
blurb: A whole sea bream or bass baked with garlic, lemon, herbs and butter.
ingredients: 2 whole sea bream or bass, gutted and scored
60g soft butter, 4 garlic cloves, zest of 1 lemon, handful of parsley and dill
method: Beat the butter with the garlic, lemon zest and herbs.
Scatter the potatoes in a tray, sit the fish on top and stuff with lemon slices; dot with the herb butter.
Bake at 200C fan for 20-25 minutes until the flesh flakes.
Serve with the buttery potatoes and greens.

name: Spiced Red Lentil Soup
blurb: Cheap, fast and warming — red lentils, cumin, smoked paprika and lemon.
ingredients: 2 tsp cumin, 1 tsp smoked paprika, 1/2 tsp turmeric, pinch of chilli
Juice of 1 lemon, coriander, olive oil to finish
method: Soften the onion and carrot in oil for 8 minutes, add the garlic and spices for 1 minute.
Add the lentils and stock and simmer for 20 minutes until the lentils collapse.
Blitz half for body, or leave rustic. Season and add the lemon.
Serve with coriander and a swirl of oil.

name: Big-Batch Minestrone
blurb: A chunky vegetable and bean soup with small pasta and pesto to stir in.
ingredients: 1 onion, 2 carrots, 2 celery sticks, 1 courgette, diced
method: Soften the onion, carrot and celery in oil for 10 minutes, add garlic and courgette.
Add the tomatoes, beans and stock and simmer for 15 minutes.
Stir in the pasta and kale and cook 10 minutes until tender.
Season well and serve with a spoon of pesto and grated Parmesan.

name: Chicken Tortilla Soup
blurb: A smoky tomato and chipotle broth with shredded chicken, topped with crisp tortilla.
ingredients: 2 tbsp smoked paprika, 1 tbsp cumin, 1-2 tsp chipotle paste
Tortillas cut into strips and fried, avocado, lime, coriander
method: Fry the onion and pepper, add the garlic and spices, then the tomatoes and stock.
Simmer 15 minutes, then add the beans and chicken and warm through.
Crisp the tortilla strips in a little oil.
Ladle the soup into bowls and top with tortilla strips, avocado, lime and coriander.

name: Ribollita (Tuscan Bread & Bean Soup)
blurb: A thick, rustic soup of cannellini beans, cavolo nero and stale bread.
method: Soften the soffritto in olive oil for 12-15 minutes.
Add the tomatoes, one tin of beans (mashed) and the stock, and simmer 20 minutes.
Add the cavolo nero and the whole beans and cook 15 minutes.
Stir in the bread and let it break down for 10 minutes; serve with a generous glug of oil.

name: Beef & Guinness Stew
blurb: Beef slow-braised in stout with root vegetables until spoonably tender.
ingredients: Mashed potato or crusty bread to serve
method: Toss the beef in seasoned flour and brown in batches in a casserole.
Soften the vegetables, stir in the purée, then add the stout and let it reduce.
Return the beef, add the stock and herbs, cover and cook at 150C fan for 2.5 hours.
Season and serve with mash or bread.

name: Tom Kha Gai (Thai Coconut Chicken Soup)
blurb: Creamy coconut broth with chicken, mushrooms, lemongrass and lime.
ingredients: 2 lemongrass stalks bruised, 5 slices galangal or ginger, 4 lime leaves
2 tbsp fish sauce, 1 tsp sugar, juice of 2 limes
method: Simmer the stock with the lemongrass, galangal and lime leaves for 10 minutes.
Add the coconut milk and chicken and poach gently for 8 minutes.
Add the mushrooms for 3 minutes, then season with fish sauce, sugar and lime.
Serve with sliced chilli and coriander.

name: French Onion Soup
blurb: Deeply caramelised onions in beef broth under a molten gruyère crouton.
method: Cook the onions low and slow in the butter and oil for 40-45 minutes until deep brown; add the sugar near the end.
Stir in the flour, then the wine and let it reduce.
Add the stock, bay and thyme and simmer 20 minutes. Season.
Ladle into bowls, float a baguette slice on each, pile with gruyère and grill until bubbling.

name: Harira (Moroccan Lentil & Chickpea Soup)
blurb: A thick, spiced tomato soup with lentils, chickpeas and fresh herbs.
ingredients: 2 tsp each cumin, ginger, cinnamon, 1 tsp turmeric, pinch of saffron
Big handful each parsley and coriander
method: Soften the onion and celery, add the spices for 1 minute.
Add the lentils, tomatoes and stock and simmer for 25 minutes.
Add the chickpeas and cook 10 minutes more, mashing a few for body.
Stir through the herbs and serve with lemon.

name: Lamb & Lentil Stew
blurb: Braised lamb with green lentils, carrots and rosemary — a one-pot bowl of comfort.
method: Brown the lamb in a casserole, then set aside.
Soften the vegetables, add the garlic and purée.
Return the lamb, add the lentils, stock and herbs, cover and simmer gently for 1 hour until the lamb is tender and the lentils soft.
Season and finish with parsley.

name: Roasted Tomato & Basil Soup
blurb: Slow-roasted tomatoes blitzed silky, with basil and a crème fraîche swirl.
ingredients: 1 tbsp tomato purée, 1 tsp sugar, 500ml stock
Big handful of basil, splash of crème fraîche
method: Roast the tomatoes, onion and garlic with the oil at 200C fan for 30 minutes until charred.
Squeeze the garlic out of its skins and blitz everything with the purée, sugar and stock.
Simmer 5 minutes and season; add most of the basil.
Serve with a swirl of crème fraîche and the rest of the basil.

name: Pea & Ham Soup
blurb: Split peas simmered soft with a ham hock, blitzed to a thick green bowlful.
ingredients: Croutons and black pepper to serve
method: Simmer the ham hock in the water with the bay for 1.5 hours, skimming.
Lift out the hock, add the split peas and vegetables, and simmer 45 minutes until the peas break down.
Shred the ham off the bone and stir it back in.
Blitz half for a thick texture, season well and serve with croutons.

name: White Bean & Chorizo Stew
blurb: Smoky chorizo, butter beans and spinach in a paprika tomato broth — 20 minutes.
method: Fry the chorizo until its oil runs, then add the onion and garlic.
Stir in the paprika, then the tomatoes, beans and stock, and simmer 10 minutes.
Stir through the spinach until wilted.
Season and serve with bread to mop up.

name: Creamy Mushroom Soup
blurb: Deeply browned mushrooms, thyme, a splash of sherry and cream.
ingredients: 3 tbsp dry sherry or white wine
method: Fry the mushrooms in the butter over high heat until deeply golden — do this in batches so they colour.
Add the onion, garlic and thyme and soften.
Add the sherry, let it bubble, then the stock, and simmer 15 minutes.
Blitz until smooth (or leave chunky), stir in the cream and finish with parsley.

name: Caldo Verde
blurb: Portuguese potato and kale soup with slices of smoky chouriço.
ingredients: 200g cavolo nero or kale, very finely shredded
method: Soften the onion and garlic in oil, add the potatoes and stock, and simmer until the potatoes are soft.
Blitz smooth for a silky base.
Fry the chouriço slices until crisp; add most to the soup with the shredded greens and simmer 5 minutes.
Serve topped with the reserved chouriço and a good drizzle of oil.

name: Chicken & Sweetcorn Soup
blurb: Silky Chinese-style soup with shredded chicken, creamed corn and egg ribbons.
ingredients: 1 tbsp soy sauce, 1 tsp sesame oil
method: Bring the stock to a simmer with both corns and the soy.
Stir in the cornflour slurry and simmer until slightly thickened.
Add the chicken, then slowly pour in the beaten egg while stirring to make ribbons.
Finish with sesame oil, spring onions and white pepper.

name: Hungarian Beef Goulash
blurb: Beef braised with masses of sweet paprika, peppers and caraway.
ingredients: 4 tbsp sweet paprika, 1 tsp caraway seeds
Soured cream and parsley to serve
method: Brown the beef, then set aside. Soften the onions until deep golden.
Off the heat stir in the paprika and caraway (don't let it burn), then the purée.
Add the beef, peppers, tomatoes and stock, cover and simmer 1.5 hours.
Add the potatoes for the last 30 minutes. Serve with soured cream and parsley.

name: Beef & Broccoli Stir-Fry
blurb: Tender beef strips and broccoli in a glossy garlic-ginger-oyster sauce.
ingredients: Sauce: 3 tbsp oyster sauce, 2 tbsp soy, 1 tbsp Shaoxing wine, 1 tsp sugar, 1 tsp cornflour, 100ml water
method: Toss the beef with a little soy and cornflour; sear in a very hot wok in batches and set aside.
Stir-fry the broccoli with a splash of water until bright and just tender.
Add the garlic and ginger, then the sauce, and let it thicken.
Return the beef and toss for 30 seconds; serve with rice.

name: Chicken with Cashew Nuts
blurb: Stir-fried chicken, peppers and cashews in a mild chilli-jam sauce.
ingredients: Sauce: 2 tbsp oyster sauce, 1 tbsp soy, 1 tbsp chilli jam or sweet chilli, 1 tsp sugar
method: Toast the cashews in the dry wok; set aside.
Stir-fry the chicken until browned, add the onion and pepper.
Add the garlic, then the sauce, and toss until sticky.
Fold in the cashews and spring onions.

name: Pad See Ew
blurb: Wide rice noodles charred in dark soy with egg, chicken and greens.
ingredients: 250g fresh wide rice noodles (or 150g dried, soaked)
Sauce: 2 tbsp dark soy, 1 tbsp light soy, 1 tbsp oyster sauce, 1 tsp sugar
method: Stir-fry the chicken in a screaming-hot wok until browned.
Push aside, scramble the egg, then add the garlic and greens.
Add the noodles and sauce and toss hard, letting the noodles catch and char.
Serve with chilli vinegar.

name: Pad Kee Mao (Drunken Noodles)
blurb: Fiery wide-noodle stir-fry with holy basil, chilli and garlic.
ingredients: Sauce: 2 tbsp soy, 1 tbsp oyster sauce, 1 tbsp fish sauce, 1 tsp sugar
Big handful of holy or Thai basil
method: Pound the garlic and chilli to a rough paste.
Stir-fry the chicken until browned, add the garlic-chilli paste and vegetables.
Add the noodles and sauce and toss over the highest heat.
Stir through the basil until just wilted.

name: Black Pepper Beef
blurb: Beef and onions in a punchy, buttery black pepper sauce.
ingredients: Sauce: 3 tbsp oyster sauce, 2 tbsp soy, 1 tbsp Shaoxing wine, 1 tsp sugar
method: Sear the beef in a hot wok in batches; set aside.
Fry the onions until charred at the edges, add the garlic and pepper.
Add the sauce and butter and let it emulsify.
Return the beef and toss to coat; serve with rice.

name: Tofu in Black Bean Sauce
blurb: Crisp tofu and peppers in a savoury fermented black bean sauce.
ingredients: 450g firm tofu, cubed, tossed in cornflour
2 tbsp fermented black beans, rinsed and mashed
Sauce: 2 tbsp soy, 1 tbsp Shaoxing wine, 1 tsp sugar, 1 tsp cornflour, 150ml water
method: Fry the tofu in shallow oil until crisp; drain.
Stir-fry the onion and peppers, add the garlic, ginger and black beans.
Add the sauce and let it thicken.
Fold the tofu through and serve with rice.

name: Mongolian Lamb
blurb: Crispy lamb strips in a sticky sweet-savoury soy sauce with spring onion.
ingredients: Sauce: 4 tbsp soy, 3 tbsp brown sugar, 1 tbsp hoisin, 1 tbsp rice vinegar, 100ml water
method: Toss the lamb in cornflour and fry in shallow oil until crisp; drain.
Fry the garlic and ginger in a little oil, add the sauce and bubble until syrupy.
Return the lamb and spring onions and toss to glaze.
Serve with rice.

name: Hoisin Duck Noodles
blurb: Shredded crispy duck tossed through noodles with hoisin, cucumber and spring onion.
ingredients: 2 duck legs, roasted and shredded (or shop crispy duck)
Sauce: 4 tbsp hoisin, 2 tbsp soy, 1 tbsp rice vinegar, 1 tsp sesame oil, 1 tsp honey
method: Cook the noodles and toss with a little sesame oil.
Warm the shredded duck in a hot pan until the edges crisp.
Toss the noodles with the sauce, then fold in the duck, cucumber and spring onion.
Finish with sesame.

name: Vegetable Lo Mein
blurb: Soft egg noodles tossed with cabbage, carrot, mushrooms and a savoury sauce.
ingredients: Sauce: 3 tbsp soy, 1 tbsp dark soy, 1 tbsp oyster sauce (or veg), 1 tsp sesame oil, 1 tsp sugar
method: Cook the noodles and toss with oil.
Stir-fry the mushrooms until golden, add the carrot and cabbage.
Add the garlic, then the noodles and sauce, and toss over high heat.
Fold through the spring onions.

name: Honey Sesame Chicken
blurb: Crisp chicken pieces in a sticky honey-soy-sesame glaze.
ingredients: Sauce: 4 tbsp honey, 3 tbsp soy, 2 tbsp rice vinegar, 1 tbsp ketchup, 1 tsp sesame oil, 1 tsp cornflour, 100ml water
method: Coat the chicken in egg then cornflour and shallow fry until golden and crisp; drain.
Simmer the sauce ingredients until glossy and thick.
Toss the chicken through the sauce.
Scatter with sesame and spring onions; serve with rice.

name: Ginger & Spring Onion Prawns
blurb: Prawns quickly stir-fried with masses of ginger and spring onion.
ingredients: Sauce: 2 tbsp Shaoxing wine, 2 tbsp soy, 1 tsp sugar, 1 tsp cornflour, 100ml water
method: Stir-fry the ginger and garlic in a hot wok for 30 seconds.
Add the prawns and cook until pink.
Add the sauce and spring onions and toss until glossy.
Serve with rice.

name: Szechuan Aubergine (Yu Xiang Qiezi)
blurb: Silky fried aubergine in a hot, sweet, sour and garlicky sauce.
ingredients: 1 tbsp chilli bean paste (doubanjiang), 1 tsp chilli flakes
Sauce: 2 tbsp black vinegar, 1 tbsp soy, 1 tbsp sugar, 1 tsp cornflour, 120ml water
method: Fry the aubergine in plenty of oil until deep golden and soft; drain.
Fry the chilli bean paste, garlic and ginger in a little oil until fragrant.
Add the sauce and let it thicken.
Return the aubergine and toss; finish with spring onions and serve with rice.

name: Chicken Yaki Udon
blurb: Thick udon noodles stir-fried with chicken, cabbage and a savoury-sweet sauce.
ingredients: Sauce: 3 tbsp soy, 2 tbsp mirin, 1 tbsp oyster sauce, 1 tbsp ketchup, 1 tsp sugar
method: Stir-fry the chicken until browned, add the carrot and cabbage.
Add the udon and sauce and toss over high heat until coated and hot.
Fold through the spring onions.
Top with pickled ginger and bonito if you have it.

name: Gochujang Beef Noodles
blurb: Minced beef and noodles in a fiery, sticky Korean chilli sauce.
ingredients: Sauce: 3 tbsp gochujang, 2 tbsp soy, 1 tbsp honey, 1 tbsp rice vinegar, 1 tbsp sesame oil
3 spring onions, sesame seeds, 1 fried egg per person (optional)
method: Fry the mince hard until browned and a little crisp.
Add the garlic and ginger, then the sauce, and toss.
Fold through the cooked noodles and a splash of water.
Top with spring onions, sesame and a fried egg.

name: Vegetable Singapore Noodles
blurb: Curried thin rice noodles with tofu, egg, peppers and beansprouts.
method: Fry the tofu until golden; scramble the egg and set aside.
Stir-fry the pepper and carrot, then add the curry powder for 30 seconds.
Add the drained noodles, soy and sugar and toss until coated.
Fold through the beansprouts, spring onions, tofu and egg.

name: Kung Pao Tofu
blurb: Crisp tofu with dried chillies, peanuts and a tingly Szechuan sauce.
ingredients: 10 dried red chillies, 1 tsp Szechuan peppercorns
Sauce: 2 tbsp soy, 1 tbsp black vinegar, 1 tbsp Shaoxing wine, 2 tsp sugar, 1 tsp cornflour
method: Fry the tofu in shallow oil until crisp; drain.
Fry the dried chillies and Szechuan pepper in oil for 20 seconds, then the garlic and ginger.
Add the sauce and toss until glossy.
Fold in the tofu, peanuts and spring onions.

name: Pad Krapow Gai
blurb: Minced chicken stir-fried hard with garlic, chilli and holy basil, with a crispy fried egg.
ingredients: Sauce: 1 tbsp oyster sauce, 1 tbsp soy, 1 tsp dark soy, 1 tsp sugar, 1 tsp fish sauce
Big handful of holy or Thai basil
method: Fry the garlic-chilli paste in hot oil for 20 seconds.
Add the mince and fry hard until browned and a little crisp.
Add the sauce and a splash of water, then the basil.
Fry the eggs crisp in hot oil and serve on top of the chicken and rice.

name: Cold Sesame Noodles
blurb: Noodles tossed in a creamy peanut-sesame sauce with cucumber and spring onion.
ingredients: Sauce: 3 tbsp tahini or peanut butter, 2 tbsp soy, 1 tbsp black vinegar, 1 tbsp sesame oil, 1 tbsp honey, 1 tsp chilli oil, water to loosen
3 spring onions, crushed peanuts, sesame seeds
method: Cook the noodles, rinse under cold water and drain well.
Whisk the sauce with enough water to make it pourable.
Toss the noodles with the sauce and cucumber.
Top with spring onions, peanuts and sesame.

name: Teriyaki Salmon Noodles
blurb: Glazed salmon flaked through noodles with pak choi and sesame.
ingredients: Sauce: 4 tbsp soy, 3 tbsp mirin, 2 tbsp honey, 1 tsp grated ginger
method: Grill the salmon, brushing with half the sauce, for 8-10 minutes.
Cook the noodles and pak choi together for the last 2 minutes.
Toss the noodles and greens with the remaining sauce.
Flake the salmon over and finish with sesame and spring onions.

name: Egg Drop Noodle Soup
blurb: A comforting bowl of noodles in a light chicken broth with egg ribbons and greens.
ingredients: 2 tbsp soy, 1 tsp sesame oil, 1 tbsp cornflour in water
method: Bring the stock to a simmer with the soy and cornflour slurry.
Add the noodles and cook until nearly done, then the greens.
Slowly pour in the beaten egg while stirring to make ribbons.
Finish with sesame oil, spring onions and white pepper.

name: Orange Chicken
blurb: Crisp chicken in a bright, sticky orange-soy glaze.
ingredients: Sauce: juice and zest of 2 oranges, 3 tbsp soy, 2 tbsp sugar, 2 tbsp rice vinegar, 1 tsp chilli flakes, 1 tsp cornflour
method: Coat the chicken in egg then cornflour and shallow fry until golden and crisp; drain.
Simmer the sauce ingredients until glossy and thick.
Toss the chicken through the sauce off the heat so it stays crisp.
Scatter with spring onions; serve with rice.

name: Campfire Stew
blurb: The slow-cooker favourite — gammon, baked beans, peppers and a smoky BBQ tang, shredded and piled on jackets.
ingredients: 1 tbsp smoked paprika, 1 tsp mustard powder, 1 tsp Worcestershire sauce
Baked potatoes or rice, to serve
method: Sit the gammon in a slow cooker with the onions and peppers around it.
Mix the beans, tomatoes, BBQ sauce, paprika, mustard powder, Worcestershire and vinegar and pour over.
Cook on low for 7-8 hours (or 4 hours on high), until the gammon pulls apart easily.
Lift out the gammon, shred it with two forks, discard any fat, and stir it back through the sauce.
Season (it may not need salt) and serve piled onto baked potatoes or with rice.

name: Pizza-Topped Chicken
blurb: Chicken breasts baked under passata, mozzarella and pepperoni — all the pizza, none of the base.
ingredients: 4 chicken breasts, butterflied and opened flat
1 tsp dried oregano, pinch of sugar
Fresh basil; salad or garlic-roasted veg, to serve
method: Heat the oven to 200C fan. Season the chicken and sear in a hot ovenproof pan for 2 minutes each side.
Simmer the passata with the garlic, oregano and sugar for 3 minutes; season.
Spoon the sauce over the chicken, then scatter with mozzarella, pepperoni and red onion.
Bake for 15-18 minutes until the chicken is cooked through and the cheese is bubbling and browned.
Finish with torn basil and serve with a salad or roast vegetables.

name: Chicken Cordon Bleu
blurb: Chicken breast rolled around ham and cheese, breadcrumbed and baked until crisp with a molten middle.
ingredients: 4 chicken breasts, butterflied and beaten thin
Oil spray or 3 tbsp melted butter
For a quick sauce: 150ml crème fraîche, 1 tsp Dijon, squeeze of lemon
Mashed or new potatoes and green beans, to serve
method: Spread each flattened breast with a little mustard, lay on 2 slices of ham and a layer of cheese, leaving a border. Roll up tightly and chill for 15 minutes.
Coat each roll in flour, then egg, then breadcrumbs, pressing firmly. Roll again in egg and crumbs for a thicker crust.
Sit seam-down on a lined tray, spray or brush with butter, and bake at 200C fan for 25-30 minutes until deep golden and 74C inside.
Warm the crème fraîche with the Dijon and lemon into a quick sauce.
Rest the chicken for 5 minutes, slice to show the layers, and serve with potatoes, beans and the mustard sauce.

name: Sloppy Joe Pasta Bake
blurb: Sweet-and-savoury sloppy joe mince stirred through pasta, baked under a lid of melted cheese.
ingredients: 3 tbsp tomato ketchup, 2 tbsp brown sauce, 1 tbsp brown sugar
1 tbsp Worcestershire sauce, 1 tsp smoked paprika, 1 tsp mustard
method: Brown the mince well, then add the onion, pepper and garlic and cook for 6 minutes.
Stir in the tomatoes, ketchup, brown sauce, sugar, Worcestershire, paprika and mustard and simmer for 12 minutes to a thick, glossy sauce.
Meanwhile cook the pasta until just short of done; drain, keeping a splash of the water.
Fold the pasta through the sauce with a little pasta water, tip into a baking dish and scatter with the cheese.
Bake at 200C fan for 15-18 minutes until bubbling and golden. Rest 5 minutes before serving.

name: Cheeseburger Pasta
blurb: One-pan comfort — beef mince, pasta and a burger-sauce-flavoured cheese sauce, with pickles on top.
ingredients: 1 tbsp tomato purée, 2 tbsp ketchup, 1 tbsp yellow mustard, 1 tsp Worcestershire sauce
Chopped dill pickles and diced onion, to finish
method: Brown the mince in a large deep pan, then add the onion and garlic for 4 minutes.
Stir in the tomato purée, ketchup, mustard and Worcestershire for 1 minute.
Add the dry macaroni and the stock, bring to a simmer, and cook uncovered for 10-12 minutes, stirring often, until the pasta is tender and the liquid has reduced and thickened.
Stir in the milk and cheese off the heat until you have a glossy sauce.
Serve topped with chopped pickles and a little raw onion.

name: Cheeseburger Soup
blurb: A creamy potato-and-beef soup that tastes like a cheeseburger — with all the little garnishes.
ingredients: 1 tbsp Dijon; to serve: pickles, diced tomato, spring onion, a little more cheese
method: Brown the mince, then add the onion, carrot and celery for 6 minutes and the garlic for 1.
Add the potatoes and stock, bring to a simmer and cook for 12-15 minutes until the potatoes are tender.
In a separate pan, melt the butter, whisk in the flour for 2 minutes, then whisk in the milk to a smooth sauce. Stir in the cheese and Dijon.
Stir the cheese sauce into the soup and warm through without boiling. Season well.
Serve in bowls with the burger garnishes scattered over.

name: Bánh Mì Meatballs
blurb: Lemongrass pork meatballs with quick-pickled carrot, cucumber, sriracha mayo and lots of herbs.
ingredients: 2 lemongrass stalks, minced; 3 garlic cloves and 1 thumb ginger, grated
2 tbsp fish sauce, 1 tbsp brown sugar, 3 spring onions, 1 tbsp cornflour
1 carrot and 1/4 daikon, shredded; 3 tbsp rice vinegar, 1 tbsp sugar, pinch salt
4 tbsp mayo mixed with 1 tbsp sriracha and a squeeze of lime
1/2 cucumber, sliced; coriander and mint sprigs
Steamed rice or 4 baguettes, to serve
method: Mix the pork with the lemongrass, garlic, ginger, fish sauce, sugar, spring onions and cornflour. Roll into 20 balls.
Toss the shredded carrot and daikon with the vinegar, sugar and salt; set aside to pickle.
Fry the meatballs in a little oil over medium heat for 10-12 minutes, turning, until browned and cooked through.
Build bowls (or fill baguettes) with rice, meatballs, drained pickle, cucumber and a big handful of herbs.
Drizzle with the sriracha mayo.

name: Reuben Sandwich
blurb: Salt beef or pastrami, sauerkraut, Swiss cheese and Russian dressing griddled in rye until crisp.
ingredients: For the dressing: 3 tbsp mayo, 1 tbsp ketchup, 1 tsp horseradish, 1 tsp finely chopped gherkin, dash Worcestershire
method: Mix the dressing ingredients.
Spread the dressing over all four inside faces of the bread. Build each sandwich: cheese, pastrami, sauerkraut, cheese, then close.
Butter the outsides generously.
Griddle or fry over medium heat for 3-4 minutes each side, pressing with a spatula, until the bread is deep golden and crisp and the cheese has melted.
Cut in half on the diagonal and eat hot, with a pickle on the side.

name: Cola Chicken
blurb: A slimming-club cult classic — chicken thighs braised in cola and passata until the sauce is dark and sticky.
ingredients: 1 tsp smoked paprika, 1 tsp mixed herbs, pinch chilli flakes
Steamed rice and greens, to serve
method: Brown the chicken thighs in a wide pan, then set aside. Fry the onions for 8 minutes until soft, adding the garlic for the last minute.
Pour in the cola and let it bubble hard for 3-4 minutes.
Add the passata, Worcestershire, paprika, herbs and chilli, and return the chicken.
Simmer uncovered for 20-25 minutes, turning the chicken now and then, until the sauce has reduced to a dark, glossy glaze that coats it.
Serve over rice with greens.

name: Chinese Red-Braised Beef
blurb: Beef shin slow-cooked in soy, Shaoxing, star anise and rock sugar until dark, glossy and spoonably tender.
ingredients: 900g beef shin or brisket, in 4cm chunks
3 tbsp dark soy sauce, 3 tbsp light soy sauce
1 thumb ginger, sliced; 6 garlic cloves; 4 spring onions
2 star anise, 1 cinnamon stick, 1 tsp Sichuan peppercorns, 2 dried chillies
Pak choi and steamed rice, to serve
method: Blanch the beef in boiling water for 3 minutes, then drain and rinse (this keeps the braise clear).
In a dry pot, melt the sugar to a light caramel, then add the ginger, garlic, spring onions and whole spices and stir for 30 seconds.
Add the beef, both soy sauces and the Shaoxing and toss to coat, then pour in the water.
Bring to a simmer, cover and cook very gently for 2 hours (or 150C oven) until the beef is meltingly tender.
Uncover and reduce the sauce until syrupy. Blanch the pak choi in the sauce for 2 minutes and serve everything over rice.

name: Spicy Korean Pork (Jeyuk Bokkeum)
blurb: Thin pork stir-fried hard in a fiery gochujang marinade with onion and spring onion, for rice and lettuce wraps.
ingredients: 600g pork shoulder or belly, very thinly sliced
1 tbsp toasted sesame oil, 1 tbsp brown sugar, 1 tbsp mirin
4 garlic cloves and 1 thumb ginger, grated
1 onion, sliced; 4 spring onions, in 3cm lengths
Steamed rice, lettuce leaves and kimchi, to serve
method: Mix the gochujang, gochugaru, soy, sesame oil, sugar, mirin, garlic and ginger. Add the pork and turn to coat. Leave 15 minutes.
Get a large frying pan or wok very hot with a little oil.
Add the pork and onion in a single layer and cook, tossing, for 5-6 minutes until the pork is caramelised at the edges and cooked through.
Throw in the spring onions and toss for 30 seconds.
Serve with rice, lettuce leaves for wrapping and kimchi.

name: Sweet & Sour Meatballs
blurb: Pork-and-beef meatballs in a glossy sweet-sour sauce with peppers, onion and pineapple, over rice.
ingredients: 1 egg, 40g breadcrumbs, 2 spring onions, 1 tsp five-spice, 1 tsp grated ginger
1 x 227g tin pineapple chunks (keep the juice)
For the sauce: 4 tbsp rice vinegar, 3 tbsp ketchup, 2 tbsp soy sauce, 2 tbsp sugar, 1 tbsp cornflour, the pineapple juice
method: Mix the minces with the egg, breadcrumbs, spring onions, five-spice and ginger. Roll into 20 balls.
Brown the meatballs all over in a wide pan, then lift out.
Stir-fry the peppers and onion for 3 minutes so they keep bite.
Whisk the sauce ingredients, pour into the pan and bubble until thick and glossy, then return the meatballs with the pineapple.
Simmer for 5 minutes until the meatballs are cooked through and coated. Serve over rice.

name: Kofta Curry
blurb: Spiced lamb meatballs simmered in a rich onion-and-tomato masala, finished with cream and coriander.
ingredients: 1 small onion grated and squeezed dry, 2 tbsp ginger-garlic paste, 1 green chilli
1 tsp garam masala, 1 tsp ground cumin, 1/2 tsp chilli powder, small bunch coriander
For the sauce: 2 onions puréed, 2 tbsp ginger-garlic paste, 400g chopped tomatoes
2 tbsp curry paste or 1 tbsp each ground coriander, cumin and paprika, 1 tsp turmeric
3 tbsp oil; rice or naan, to serve
method: Mix the mince with the grated onion, half the ginger-garlic paste, the chilli, garam masala, cumin, chilli powder and half the coriander. Roll into 16 balls and chill.
Fry the puréed onion in the oil over medium heat for 12 minutes until golden and thick, then add the rest of the ginger-garlic paste and the ground spices for 2 minutes.
Add the tomatoes and 200ml water and simmer for 10 minutes to a smooth, glossy masala.
Gently lower in the koftas, cover and simmer for 20 minutes, turning once, until cooked through and the sauce clings.
Stir in the cream, scatter with the rest of the coriander, and serve with rice or naan.

name: Hiyashi Chūka
blurb: Japanese cold ramen — chilled noodles under neat rows of ham, egg, cucumber and tomato with a tangy sesame-soy dressing.
ingredients: 2 nests ramen or medium egg noodles
2 eggs, made into thin omelettes and shredded
100g sliced ham or cooked chicken, shredded
For the dressing: 3 tbsp soy sauce, 2 tbsp rice vinegar, 1 tbsp sugar, 1 tbsp toasted sesame oil, 1 tsp grated ginger, 2 tbsp water
Toasted sesame seeds and a little English mustard, to serve
method: Whisk the dressing ingredients until the sugar dissolves; chill.
Cook the noodles, then rinse under cold running water until completely cold and drain very well. Toss with a drop of sesame oil.
Divide the noodles between two shallow bowls.
Arrange the ham, shredded omelette, cucumber, tomato and spring onions in separate sections on top.
Pour the cold dressing around the noodles and finish with sesame seeds and a dab of mustard to stir in.

name: Firecracker Chicken
blurb: Crisp-coated chicken tossed in a sticky, glossy sauce that's equal parts sweet, sour and fiery.
ingredients: Spray oil (for oven/air-fryer) or oil for shallow frying
For the sauce: 4 tbsp sweet chilli sauce, 2 tbsp sriracha, 2 tbsp rice vinegar, 1 tbsp soy sauce, 1 tbsp honey, 1 tsp chilli flakes, 2 garlic cloves crushed
1 tsp cornflour slaked in 1 tbsp water
Spring onions and sesame seeds; steamed rice and broccoli, to serve
method: Toss the chicken in the egg, then the cornflour, to a loose coating.
Air-fry at 200C for 12-14 minutes (spray with oil, shake once), oven-bake at 220C for 18 minutes, or shallow fry until deep golden and crisp.
Simmer the sauce ingredients in a wide pan for 2 minutes, then stir in the slaked cornflour and cook to a thick, glossy glaze.
Add the crisp chicken and toss fast to coat while it stays crunchy.
Scatter with spring onions and sesame seeds and serve with rice and steamed broccoli.

name: Full English Breakfast Risotto
blurb: A cheeky breakfast-for-dinner — creamy risotto studded with sausage, bacon, mushroom and tomato, topped with a fried egg.
ingredients: 6 sausages, skins removed and rolled into small balls
4 eggs, fried, to serve; brown sauce on the side
method: Fry the sausage balls and lardons in a wide pan until browned; lift out. Fry the mushrooms until golden and set aside.
Soften the onion in the pan fat for 6 minutes, then stir in the rice for 1 minute.
Add the wine and let it absorb, then add the stock a ladle at a time, stirring, for about 18 minutes until the rice is creamy and just tender.
Fold in the sausage, bacon, mushrooms and cherry tomatoes and warm through. Beat in the butter and cheese.
Serve each bowl topped with a fried egg and a squiggle of brown sauce.

name: French Onion Risotto
blurb: Deeply caramelised onions, beef stock and a lid of grilled Gruyère — French onion soup in risotto form.
ingredients: 1 tsp sugar, few sprigs thyme, 1 bay leaf
1.3 litres hot vegetable or beef-style stock
Toasted baguette slices (optional), to float on top
method: Cook the onions in the butter and oil over low heat with the sugar, thyme and bay for 30-35 minutes, stirring, until deep brown and jammy.
Turn up the heat, add the wine and let it bubble away, then stir in the rice for 1 minute.
Add the stock a ladle at a time, stirring, for about 18 minutes until the rice is creamy and just tender. Stir in the Dijon and Parmesan.
Spoon into ovenproof bowls, top with the Gruyère (and a baguette slice each if using), and grill until molten and bubbling.
Serve straight away, with a green salad.

name: Guinness Pulled Pork with Colcannon
blurb: Pork shoulder slow-cooked in stout until it shreds, piled on buttery cabbage-and-spring-onion mash.
ingredients: 3 tbsp brown sugar, 2 tbsp cider vinegar, 2 tbsp Dijon mustard, 1 tbsp Worcestershire sauce
For the colcannon: 1.2kg floury potatoes, 1/2 Savoy cabbage shredded, 6 spring onions, 100g butter, 100ml milk
method: Season the pork all over and brown it in a casserole. Add the onions, then the Guinness, sugar, vinegar, mustard, Worcestershire and bay.
Cover and cook at 150C for 4-5 hours, turning once, until the pork pulls apart with a fork.
Shred the pork, skim the fat from the liquor and boil it down to a sticky sauce, then toss the pork through.
For the colcannon, boil the potatoes and mash. Wilt the cabbage and spring onions in the butter, then beat into the mash with the milk. Season well.
Pile the pulled pork over big spoonfuls of colcannon, with greens on the side.

name: Salt & Pepper Chips
blurb: Chip-shop chips tossed in a crackling stir-fry of onion, pepper, chilli and five-spice — a takeaway in a bowl.
ingredients: 1kg floury potatoes, cut into chips (or 1kg oven chips)
2 red chillies, sliced; 3 garlic cloves, minced
1 tbsp Chinese five-spice, 1 tsp Sichuan pepper (optional), 1 tbsp flaky salt, 1 tsp white pepper
method: Cook the chips until crisp and golden — deep-fry in two goes, or roast at 220C fan for 35-40 minutes, turning.
Mix the five-spice, Sichuan pepper, salt and white pepper.
Get a wok very hot with the oil. Stir-fry the onion, peppers and chillies for 2 minutes, then the garlic and spring onions for 30 seconds.
Tip in the hot chips, sprinkle over the spice-salt mix and the soy sauce, and toss hard for 1-2 minutes so everything is coated and sizzling.
Serve at once, as a sharing plate or piled next to something simple like plain chicken.

name: Turkey Stroganoff
blurb: A lighter stroganoff — strips of turkey and mushrooms in a mustard, paprika and soured-cream sauce.
ingredients: 600g turkey breast steaks, sliced into strips
1 tbsp smoked paprika, 1 tsp sweet paprika
150g soured cream or half-fat crème fraîche
Chopped parsley; rice or tagliatelle, to serve
method: Season the turkey and fry in a little oil in a wide pan over high heat for 3-4 minutes until just cooked; lift out.
Add the onions and mushrooms and cook for 8 minutes until softened and browned, adding the garlic and paprikas for the last minute.
Stir in the mustard and stock and simmer for 3 minutes.
Lower the heat, stir in the soured cream and return the turkey; warm through without boiling.
Season, scatter with parsley, and serve over rice or tagliatelle.

name: Philly Cheesesteak Stuffed Peppers
blurb: Peppers packed with seared steak, onion and mushroom, blanketed in melted provolone.
ingredients: 4 large peppers, halved lengthways and deseeded
500g minute steak or sirloin, very thinly sliced
method: Sit the pepper halves cut-side up in a baking dish and roast at 200C fan for 12 minutes to soften slightly.
Sear the steak in a screaming-hot pan in batches for 1 minute so it browns; set aside.
Fry the onions and mushrooms in the same pan for 8-10 minutes until deeply browned, adding the garlic and Worcestershire at the end. Fold the steak back in and season.
Pile the filling into the pepper halves and top each with a slice of cheese.
Bake for 12-15 minutes until the peppers are tender and the cheese is molten and blistered. Serve with a salad.

name: Harissa Chicken & Chickpea Traybake
blurb: Rose harissa chicken thighs roasted with chickpeas, peppers and red onion.
ingredients: 3 tbsp olive oil, juice of 1 lemon
2 peppers and 2 red onions, in wedges
method: Rub the chicken with the harissa, half the oil and the lemon; leave 20 minutes.
Toss the chickpeas, peppers and onions with the rest of the oil and the cumin in a large tray.
Sit the chicken on top and roast at 200C fan for 35-40 minutes until charred and cooked.
Serve with dollops of yoghurt and plenty of coriander.

name: Sausage, Gnocchi & Tomato Traybake
blurb: Sausage meat, gnocchi and cherry tomatoes roasted together until crisp and sticky.
ingredients: 6 good sausages, skins removed, torn into chunks
1 tsp fennel seeds, 1/2 tsp chilli flakes, 3 tbsp olive oil
method: Toss everything except the mozzarella and basil in a large tray.
Roast at 220C fan for 25 minutes, stirring once, until the sausage is browned and tomatoes burst.
Scatter over the mozzarella and return for 5 minutes.
Finish with basil.

name: Salmon, Potato & Green Bean Traybake
blurb: Salmon roasted over crushed new potatoes and beans with lemon and dill.
method: Toss the potatoes with oil and roast at 200C fan for 20 minutes.
Add the beans and lemon slices, sit the salmon on top and season.
