Roast 12-14 minutes until the salmon flakes.
Scatter with dill and serve with crème fraîche.

name: Greek Lamb & Potato Traybake
blurb: Lemon-oregano lamb steaks roasted with potatoes, olives and feta.
ingredients: Juice of 2 lemons, 6 tbsp olive oil
method: Toss the potatoes with the lemon, oil, garlic and oregano in a large tray. Roast at 200C fan for 25 minutes.
Nestle in the seasoned lamb and the olives.
Roast 15-20 minutes more until the lamb is pink and the potatoes tender.
Crumble over the feta and rest 5 minutes.

name: Spanish Chicken & Chorizo Rice Traybake
blurb: Smoky one-tray rice with chicken thighs, chorizo, peppers and peas.
method: Brown the chicken and chorizo in a roasting tin on the hob, then stir in the onion, pepper, garlic and paprika.
Stir in the rice, pour over the hot stock, and arrange the chicken on top.
Cover with foil and bake at 190C fan for 30 minutes.
Stir through the peas, re-cover for 5 minutes, then rest and finish with lemon and parsley.

name: Roast Pork with Crackling & Apple Sauce
blurb: Slow-roast pork shoulder with crisp crackling, roast potatoes and gravy.
ingredients: Apple sauce: 3 Bramley apples, 2 tbsp sugar, knob of butter
Gravy: 1 tbsp flour, 400ml stock, splash of cider
method: Rub the skin with oil and lots of salt. Roast at 240C fan for 30 minutes, then 160C fan for about 3 hours until tender.
Turn the oven back up, parboil and roughen the potatoes, and roast in hot fat for 45-55 minutes.
Simmer the apples with a splash of water and the sugar to a sauce; beat in the butter.
Rest the pork 20 minutes; make gravy in the tin with the flour, cider and stock. Carve and serve.

name: Whole Roasted Baharat Cauliflower
blurb: A whole spiced cauliflower roasted until charred, with tahini and pomegranate.
ingredients: 2 tbsp baharat or ras el hanout
Tahini sauce: 4 tbsp tahini, juice of 1 lemon, 1 garlic clove, water
Seeds of 1 pomegranate, handful of parsley, toasted flaked almonds
method: Steam or parboil the whole cauliflower for 8 minutes, then drain well.
Rub all over with the oil and spice and sit in a tray.
Roast at 200C fan for 40-45 minutes until deeply charred and tender.
Cut into wedges and serve drizzled with tahini and scattered with pomegranate, parsley and almonds.

name: Jerk Chicken Traybake
blurb: Marinated jerk chicken thighs roasted with sweet potato, pepper and pineapple.
ingredients: 4 tbsp jerk paste (or blitz: 3 spring onions, 2 Scotch bonnets, 4 garlic cloves, 3cm ginger, 1 tbsp allspice, 1 tbsp thyme, 2 tbsp soy, 2 tbsp brown sugar, juice of 1 lime)
method: Coat the chicken in the jerk paste and marinate at least 1 hour.
Spread the sweet potato and peppers in a tray with a little oil and roast at 200C fan for 15 minutes.
Add the chicken and pineapple and roast 30-35 minutes more until charred and cooked.
Serve with lime wedges (and rice and peas if you like).

name: Roasted Veg & Halloumi Traybake
blurb: Mediterranean veg and thick halloumi slabs roasted with honey and oregano.
ingredients: 2 courgettes, 2 peppers, 1 red onion, 250g cherry tomatoes, chopped
4 tbsp olive oil, 1 tbsp honey, 1 tbsp dried oregano
method: Toss the vegetables with the oil and oregano in a large tray and roast at 200C fan for 20 minutes.
Nestle in the halloumi, drizzle with the honey.
Roast 12-15 minutes more until the halloumi is golden and the veg is soft.
Serve with warm flatbreads and a squeeze of lemon.

name: One-Tray Lemon & Thyme Roast Chicken
blurb: A whole chicken roasted over potatoes, lemon and garlic — the whole dinner in one tin.
method: Toss the potatoes, garlic and half the lemon with the oil in a large deep tray.
Rub the chicken with butter and season; put the rest of the lemon and thyme in the cavity and sit it on the potatoes.
Roast at 200C fan for 75-85 minutes, basting once, until the juices run clear.
Rest 15 minutes; squeeze the roasted garlic and lemon over everything to serve.

name: Sticky Gochujang Chicken Traybake
blurb: Korean chilli-glazed chicken roasted with spring onion and sesame, over rice.
ingredients: Glaze: 3 tbsp gochujang, 2 tbsp soy, 2 tbsp honey, 1 tbsp rice vinegar, 1 tbsp sesame oil, 3 garlic cloves, 2cm ginger
1 bunch spring onions, cut into lengths
Rice and quick-pickled cucumber to serve
method: Mix the glaze and toss with the chicken; marinate 20 minutes.
Spread in a tray with the spring onions and roast at 200C fan for 30-35 minutes, basting once, until sticky and charred.
Scatter with sesame seeds.
Serve over rice with pickled cucumber.

name: Cod, Chorizo & Butter Bean Traybake
blurb: Cod roasted on smoky chorizo, butter beans and cherry tomatoes.
ingredients: 3 tbsp olive oil, 1 tsp smoked paprika
method: Toss the chorizo, beans, tomatoes and onion with the oil and paprika in a tray.
Roast at 200C fan for 15 minutes until the chorizo oil runs and the tomatoes soften.
Sit the seasoned cod on top and roast 10-12 minutes until it flakes.
Finish with parsley and a squeeze of lemon.

name: Tandoori Paneer & Pepper Traybake
blurb: Yoghurt-and-spice marinated paneer roasted with peppers and red onion.
ingredients: 3 peppers and 2 red onions, in chunks
150g thick yoghurt, 3 tbsp tandoori spice mix, 2 garlic cloves and 2cm ginger crushed, juice of half a lemon, 2 tbsp oil
Naan and mint yoghurt to serve
method: Mix the yoghurt, spice mix, garlic, ginger, lemon and oil and fold through the paneer and vegetables.
Marinate 20 minutes, then spread on a tray.
Roast at 220C fan for 20-25 minutes until charred at the edges.
Serve with warm naan and mint yoghurt.

name: Sausage, Apple & Red Cabbage Tray Roast
blurb: Sausages roasted with wedges of red cabbage, apple and red onion in balsamic.
ingredients: Half a red cabbage, in thin wedges
3 tbsp olive oil, 2 tbsp balsamic vinegar, 1 tbsp wholegrain mustard, 1 tbsp honey
method: Toss the cabbage, apple and onion with the oil, balsamic, mustard, honey and thyme in a large tray.
Roast at 200C fan for 15 minutes.
Add the sausages and roast 25-30 minutes more, turning once, until browned and the cabbage is tender.
Serve with mash.

name: Maple-Mustard Chicken & Root Veg Traybake
blurb: Chicken thighs roasted with carrots, parsnips and new potatoes in a maple-mustard glaze.
ingredients: Glaze: 2 tbsp maple syrup, 2 tbsp wholegrain mustard, 3 tbsp olive oil, few rosemary sprigs
method: Toss the potatoes, carrots, parsnips and onions with half the glaze in a large tray and roast at 200C fan for 20 minutes.
Add the chicken, brush with the rest of the glaze, and roast 30-35 minutes more.
Baste with the pan juices and serve.

name: Spinach Dal
blurb: Yellow lentils cooked soft with spinach and a garlicky cumin tarka.
ingredients: Tarka: 3 tbsp oil, 1 tsp cumin seeds, 4 garlic cloves, 1 dried chilli, 1 tomato
method: Simmer the lentils with the turmeric and 1 litre water for 25 minutes; whisk loose and season.
Stir through the spinach until wilted.
Fry the cumin then garlic in oil until golden, add the chilli and tomato.
Pour the tarka over the dal; finish with garam masala and lemon.

name: Chana Masala
blurb: Chickpeas simmered with onion, tomato and warm spice, sharpened with amchur.
ingredients: 2 tsp cumin, 2 tsp coriander, 1 tsp turmeric, 1 tsp chilli
1 tsp amchur or lemon, 1 tsp garam masala
method: Fry the onion until deep golden, add garlic, ginger and ground spices.
Add the tomatoes and cook down 8 minutes.
Add the chickpeas and a splash of water; simmer 10 minutes, mashing some.
Stir in the amchur and garam masala; finish with coriander.

name: Crispy Tofu Katsu Curry
blurb: Panko tofu slabs with a mild Japanese curry sauce and rice.
ingredients: 2 x 280g blocks firm tofu, pressed and halved
2 tbsp mild curry powder, 1 tbsp flour, 1 tbsp garam masala
method: Soften the onion and carrot, add garlic, ginger, spices, then flour.
Whisk in the stock, soy and maple; simmer 15 minutes and blitz smooth.
Coat the tofu in flour, milk and panko; shallow fry until golden and crisp.
Slice and serve over rice with the sauce.

name: BBQ Jackfruit Tacos
blurb: Pulled young jackfruit in a smoky barbecue sauce with a crunchy slaw.
ingredients: 2 x 400g tins young jackfruit in water, drained and shredded
1 tbsp smoked paprika, 1 tsp cumin, 1 tsp chipotle
method: Fry the onion and garlic, add the spices and shredded jackfruit.
Add the barbecue sauce and stock and simmer 15 minutes, shredding further with a fork.
Warm the tortillas.
Fill with the jackfruit, slaw, lime and coriander.

name: Mushroom Stroganoff
blurb: Mixed mushrooms in a paprika-mustard cream sauce over rice or pasta.
ingredients: 150ml vegetable stock, 200g soured cream (or crème fraîche)
Splash of white wine, parsley, rice or pasta
method: Fry the mushrooms in batches over high heat until deeply golden.
Soften the onion, add the garlic, paprika and mustard.
Add the wine and stock, let it reduce, then stir in the soured cream.
Return the mushrooms, warm through, and serve over rice with parsley.

name: Lentil Bolognese
blurb: A rich, meaty-tasting ragù of lentils, mushrooms and tomato over spaghetti.
ingredients: 2 tbsp tomato purée, 1 tbsp Marmite or soy
method: Soften the soffritto and mushrooms for 12 minutes.
Add the purée and Marmite, then the wine and reduce.
Add the tomatoes and lentils and a splash of water; simmer 25 minutes.
Toss with spaghetti and pasta water.

name: Chilli Non Carne
blurb: Three beans, sweet potato and lentils in a deep smoky chipotle sauce.
ingredients: 400g tin each kidney, black and pinto beans
2 tbsp smoked paprika, 1 tbsp cumin, 1 tbsp cocoa, 1-2 tsp chipotle
method: Fry the onion and pepper, add the garlic and spices.
Add the sweet potato, lentils, tomatoes and 300ml water; simmer 20 minutes.
Add the beans and cook 15 minutes more until thick.
Serve over rice with lime and coriard.

name: Halloumi Fajita Bowls
blurb: Charred halloumi, peppers and onions over rice with guac and salsa.
ingredients: 2 tbsp fajita spice, juice of 1 lime, 2 tbsp oil
method: Toss the peppers and onions with the spice, lime and oil.
Char in a screaming-hot pan until soft with black edges.
Fry the halloumi separately until golden.
Build bowls with rice, the charred veg, halloumi and toppings.

name: Aubergine Katsu Sando
blurb: Panko aubergine, cabbage and katsu sauce in fluffy white bread.
ingredients: 4 slices soft white bread, butter or vegan spread
method: Salt the aubergine slabs 15 minutes, then pat dry.
Coat in flour, milk then panko; shallow fry until deep golden and soft.
Butter the bread; toss the cabbage with a little sauce.
Build sandwiches with cabbage, aubergine and lots of katsu sauce; press and slice.

name: Black Bean Burgers
blurb: Smoky, spiced homemade bean patties with all the trimmings.
ingredients: 2 x 400g tins black beans, drained and dried
60g breadcrumbs, 2 tbsp flour, 1 tbsp smoked paprika, 1 tbsp cumin, 1 tsp chipotle
1 flax egg (1 tbsp ground flax + 3 tbsp water)
4 buns, lettuce, tomato, red onion, burger sauce
method: Mash three-quarters of the beans; mix with the rest of the beans, fried onion, breadcrumbs, flour, spices and flax egg.
Shape into 4 patties and chill 20 minutes.
Fry in oil for 3-4 minutes each side until crisp.
Serve in toasted buns with salad and sauce.

name: Cauliflower Tikka Masala
blurb: Charred cauliflower in a creamy spiced tomato sauce.
ingredients: 1 large cauliflower, florets, tossed in oil and 2 tbsp tikka spice and roasted
1 tbsp tomato purée, 1 tsp chilli powder, 1 tsp garam masala
method: Roast the spiced cauliflower at 220C fan for 20-25 minutes until charred.
Fry the onion, garlic and ginger, add the purée and passata and simmer 15 minutes.
Stir in the cream, chilli powder and garam masala.
Fold in the cauliflower; finish with coriander.

name: Baked Gnocchi with Tomato & Mozzarella
blurb: Pillowy gnocchi baked in a rich tomato sauce under bubbling cheese.
ingredients: 3 garlic cloves, 1 tsp chilli flakes, 1 tbsp purée, 1 tsp sugar
method: Fry the garlic and chilli, add the purée, tomatoes and sugar; simmer 15 minutes.
Boil the gnocchi until they float, then drain.
Fold through the sauce in an ovenproof pan, dot with mozzarella and Parmesan.
Bake/grill at 220C for 10 minutes; finish with basil.

name: Thai Basil Tofu Stir-Fry
blurb: Crumbled tofu stir-fried hard with garlic, chilli and holy basil, over rice.
ingredients: Sauce: 1 tbsp soy, 1 tbsp vegan oyster sauce, 1 tsp dark soy, 1 tsp sugar
Big handful of Thai basil, rice
method: Fry the tofu in hot oil until browned and a little crisp.
Add the garlic-chilli paste and vegetables for 2 minutes.
Add the sauce and a splash of water, then the basil.
Serve over rice with an extra drizzle of soy.

name: Green Lentil Shepherd's Pie
blurb: Lentils, carrots and peas in a rich gravy under herby mash.
ingredients: 2 tbsp tomato purée, 1 tbsp Marmite, 400ml stock
method: Soften the onion, carrot and celery for 12 minutes.
Add the purée, Marmite, lentils, stock and herbs; simmer 20 minutes until thick, adding the peas at the end.
Top with olive-oil mash and fork the surface.
Bake at 200C fan for 25 minutes until golden.

name: Tofu Scramble Breakfast Tacos
blurb: Turmeric tofu scramble with peppers and black beans in warm tortillas.
ingredients: 1 tsp turmeric, 1 tsp cumin, 1 tbsp nutritional yeast, pinch of black salt
8 small tortillas, avocado, salsa, coriander, lime
method: Fry the onion and pepper until soft.
Add the tofu and spices with a splash of water and cook 5 minutes.
Warm the tortillas and beans.
Fill with the scramble, beans, avocado and salsa; finish with lime.

name: Miso-Glazed Aubergine Rice Bowl
blurb: Aubergine roasted under a sticky sweet-savoury miso glaze with rice and greens.
ingredients: Glaze: 3 tbsp white miso, 2 tbsp mirin, 1 tbsp maple, 1 tbsp rice vinegar, 1 tsp grated ginger
Steamed greens, sesame seeds, spring onions
method: Score the aubergine halves and roast cut-side up at 200C fan for 20 minutes.
Brush with the glaze and roast 12-15 minutes more until sticky.
Cook the rice and greens.
Serve the aubergine over rice with greens, sesame and spring onions.

name: West African Peanut Stew
blurb: Sweet potato, chickpeas and greens in a rich peanut-tomato broth.
ingredients: 1 onion, 4 garlic cloves, 3cm ginger, 1 Scotch bonnet (whole)
100g peanut butter, 2 tbsp tomato purée, 400g tin chopped tomatoes
method: Fry the onion, garlic and ginger, add the purée.
Add the sweet potato, tomatoes, stock and whole Scotch bonnet; simmer 15 minutes.
Whisk in the peanut butter and chickpeas and simmer 10 minutes.
Stir through the greens; remove the chilli and serve over rice with peanuts and coriander.

name: Cauliflower Steaks with Romesco
blurb: Thick roasted cauliflower slabs with a smoky roasted-pepper and almond sauce.
ingredients: 2 large cauliflowers, cut into thick steaks
4 tbsp olive oil, 1 tsp smoked paprika
Romesco: 1 jar roasted peppers, 50g toasted almonds, 1 garlic clove, 1 tbsp sherry vinegar, 1 tsp smoked paprika, 4 tbsp olive oil
method: Brush the cauliflower steaks with oil and paprika and roast at 220C fan for 25-30 minutes, turning once.
Blitz the romesco ingredients to a thick, rough sauce.
Spread romesco on plates and sit the cauliflower on top.
Scatter with parsley and almonds.

name: Mushroom & Chestnut Wellington
blurb: A whole roasted mushroom log with chestnut stuffing in crisp pastry.
ingredients: 1 onion, 3 garlic cloves, 1 tsp thyme, 1 tsp rosemary
50g breadcrumbs, 1 tbsp soy, splash of red wine
320g vegan puff pastry, plant milk to glaze
Roast potatoes and gravy to serve
method: Fry the onion, garlic and mushrooms until dry and deeply browned.
Add the chestnuts, herbs, soy, wine and breadcrumbs to bind; cool.
Shape into a log on the pastry, wrap and seal, score the top and glaze.
Bake at 200C fan for 30-35 minutes until deep golden; rest 5 minutes.

name: Crispy Chickpea Shawarma Wraps
blurb: Spiced roasted chickpeas with pickled onion, salad and tahini in a wrap.
ingredients: 2 x 400g tins chickpeas, drained and dried
2 tbsp shawarma or baharat spice, 3 tbsp oil
Pickled red onion, shredded lettuce, tomato, cucumber
Tahini sauce: 4 tbsp tahini, juice of 1 lemon, 1 garlic clove, water
method: Toss the chickpeas with the spice and oil and roast at 220C fan for 25 minutes until crisp.
Whisk the tahini sauce until pourable.
Warm the wraps.
Fill with salad, chickpeas, pickled onion and a good drizzle of tahini.

name: Vegetable Paella
blurb: Saffron rice with artichokes, peppers, beans and peas, with a crisp base.
ingredients: 1 jar artichoke hearts, 400g tin butter beans, 150g green beans, 100g peas
1 tbsp smoked paprika, large pinch saffron, 2 tbsp tomato purée
method: Soften the onion and pepper, add the garlic, paprika and purée.
Stir in the rice, then the stock with the saffron; scatter over the vegetables.
Simmer without stirring for 18-20 minutes until the liquid is absorbed and a socarrat forms.
Rest 5 minutes; serve with lemon and parsley.

name: Honey Halloumi & Chickpea Traybake
blurb: Halloumi, chickpeas and peppers roasted with honey, harissa and lemon.
ingredients: 2 tbsp harissa, 2 tbsp honey, 3 tbsp oil, juice of 1 lemon
method: Toss the chickpeas, peppers and onions with the harissa, oil and lemon in a tray.
Roast at 200C fan for 20 minutes.
Add the halloumi, drizzle with the honey, and roast 12-15 minutes more.
Scatter with parsley; serve with yoghurt and flatbread.

name: Dal Makhani
blurb: Black lentils and kidney beans slow-simmered with butter and cream.
ingredients: 250g whole black urad lentils, soaked overnight
1 tsp each cumin, garam masala, chilli powder, 1 tsp dried fenugreek
method: Simmer the soaked lentils in fresh water for 45 minutes until soft.
Fry the onion, garlic and ginger, add the purée, passata and ground spices.
Add the drained lentils and kidney beans and simmer 20 minutes, mashing some.
Stir in the butter, cream and fenugreek and simmer 10 minutes more.

name: Roast Sweet Potato & Kale Buddha Bowl
blurb: Roasted sweet potato, crispy chickpeas, kale and grains with a lemon-tahini drizzle.
ingredients: 1 tbsp smoked paprika, 1 tsp cumin, 3 tbsp oil
200g kale, massaged with oil and lemon
Tahini sauce: 4 tbsp tahini, juice of 1 lemon, 1 garlic clove, water
method: Toss the sweet potato and chickpeas with the spices and oil and roast at 200C fan for 25-30 minutes.
Massage the kale with a little oil and lemon so it softens.
Warm the grains.
Build bowls with grains, kale, roast sweet potato and chickpeas, and a drizzle of tahini; scatter with seeds.

name: Garlic Butter Prawn Rice
blurb: A 15-minute one-pan of prawns, garlic butter and fluffy rice for one or two.
method: Melt the butter in a frying pan and soften the garlic for 1 minute.
Add the prawns and fry 2-3 minutes until pink.
Stir through the rice to heat, then finish with lemon juice and parsley.

name: Crispy Pesto Gnocchi
blurb: Pan-fried gnocchi tossed with pesto and spinach — ready in 12 minutes, one pan.
method: Fry the gnocchi in the oil over high heat for 6-8 minutes until golden and crisp.
Add the spinach and let it wilt.
Off the heat, stir through the pesto and Parmesan and serve.

name: Black Bean & Cheese Quesadilla
blurb: Store-cupboard black beans and cheese griddled in a tortilla. Ten minutes flat.
method: Mash the beans roughly with the paprika and chilli.
Spread over one tortilla, scatter with cheese and top with the second.
Griddle 2-3 minutes each side until crisp, then cut into wedges.

name: Chinese Tomato & Egg Noodles
blurb: A homely 15-minute stir-fry of soft eggs, sweet tomatoes and noodles.
method: Scramble the eggs in a hot wok until just set, then remove.
Fry the tomatoes with the sugar until saucy, season with soy.
Add cooked noodles and the eggs, toss and top with spring onion.

name: Halloumi & Harissa Flatbread
blurb: Griddled halloumi, harissa yoghurt and salad piled on warm flatbread.
method: Fry the halloumi in a dry pan until golden on both sides.
Warm the flatbreads, spread with the harissa-swirled yoghurt.
Top with leaves, cucumber and halloumi, then roll up.

name: Tuna & White Bean Salad
blurb: No-cook store-cupboard supper: tinned tuna, cannellini beans, lemon and red onion.
method: Tip the beans and tuna into a bowl.
Add the onion, lemon juice, oil and parsley.
Fold together gently, season well and serve.

name: Miso Butter Udon
blurb: Slippery udon in a glossy miso-butter sauce with spring onion. Twelve minutes.
method: Heat the udon with a splash of water in a pan.
Stir in the miso, butter and soy until it coats the noodles.
Top with spring onion and sesame.

name: Chorizo & Chickpea Skillet
blurb: Smoky chorizo, chickpeas and spinach in a tomatoey one-pan. Ready in 20.
method: Fry the chorizo until the oil runs, add the onion and soften.
Add the tomatoes, chickpeas and paprika and simmer 10 minutes.
Stir the spinach through to wilt and serve with bread.

name: Lemon & Parmesan Spaghetti
blurb: Spaghetti al limone — pasta, lemon, butter and Parmesan. Ten-minute comfort.
method: Cook the spaghetti, saving a mug of pasta water.
Toss the drained pasta with the butter, lemon, Parmesan and a splash of water.
Loosen to a silky sauce, season with pepper and serve.

name: Thai Basil Chicken (Pad Krapow)
blurb: Fiery minced chicken with holy basil over rice and a fried egg. Fifteen minutes.
method: Fry the garlic and chilli briefly, add the mince and brown.
Season with the oyster sauce, soy and sugar, then stir in the basil.
Fry the eggs hard and crisp and serve on top of the chicken and rice.

name: No-Cook Caprese Orzo
blurb: Warm orzo tossed with tomatoes, mozzarella and basil — a 15-minute assembly job.
method: Cook the orzo, drain and cool slightly.
Toss with the tomatoes, oil and balsamic and season.
Fold through the mozzarella and basil just before serving.

name: Speedy Sausage & Gnocchi
blurb: Sausagemeat, gnocchi and greens in a creamy tomato pan. Twenty minutes, one pan.
method: Fry the sausagemeat in chunks with the fennel seeds until browned.
Add the tomatoes and gnocchi with a splash of water and cook 6 minutes.
Stir in the cream and kale and simmer until the kale softens.

name: Weeknight Egg Fried Rice
blurb: Cold rice, egg, peas and spring onion — the fastest 10-minute dinner going.
method: Scramble the eggs in a hot wok, then push aside.
Add the rice and peas and fry hard for 3-4 minutes.
Season with soy and sesame oil, stir through spring onions.

name: Ten-Minute Carbonara
blurb: Pasta, egg yolks, pecorino and pancetta — no cream, all speed.
method: Cook the pasta; fry the pancetta until crisp.
Whisk the eggs with the pecorino and pepper.
Toss the hot drained pasta with the pancetta, then the egg mix off the heat, loosening with pasta water.

name: Smashed Chickpea Sandwich
blurb: A no-cook lunch-for-dinner: chickpeas mashed with mayo, mustard and celery.
method: Roughly mash the chickpeas with a fork.
Stir in the mayo, mustard and celery and season.
Pile onto bread with salad leaves.

name: Gochujang Butter Noodles
blurb: Springy noodles in a sticky, spicy gochujang-butter sauce. Twelve minutes.
method: Cook the noodles and save a splash of the water.
Melt the butter with the gochujang, garlic, soy and honey.
Toss the noodles through, loosen with water, top with spring onion.

name: Any-Greens Frittata
blurb: Whatever's in the drawer, six eggs and a hot grill. Fifteen minutes, one pan.
method: Beat the eggs with seasoning and the herbs.
Warm the veg in an oven-proof pan, pour in the eggs and dot with cheese.
Cook until almost set, then finish under a hot grill until puffed.

name: Quick Chilli-Lime Prawn Tacos
blurb: Pan-fried prawns, slaw and lime crema folded into warm tortillas. Fifteen minutes.
method: Toss the prawns with the chipotle and fry 3 minutes until pink.
Mix the soured cream with lime juice and season.
Fill the warm tortillas with cabbage, prawns and lime crema.

name: 15-Minute Dan Dan Noodles
blurb: Pork mince, chilli oil, sesame and noodles in a bowl you'll want again tomorrow.
method: Fry the pork hard until crisp and browned.
Whisk the tahini, soy and chilli oil with a little noodle water for the sauce.
Cook the noodles and pak choi, then build bowls with sauce, noodles and pork.

name: Baked Feta Pasta
blurb: The internet's favourite: a block of feta and cherry tomatoes roasted into a sauce.
method: Put the feta in the middle of a dish, surround with tomatoes, oil and garlic.
Roast at 200C for 30 minutes until collapsing.
Mash together, toss with cooked pasta and basil.

name: Tomato Soup & Grilled Cheese
blurb: Blitzed tinned-tomato soup and a molten cheese toastie. The ultimate 20-minute night in.
method: Soften the onion, add the tomatoes and sugar and simmer 10 minutes, then blitz with the cream.
Butter the bread, fill with cheese and fry until golden both sides.
Serve the toastie cut in half alongside the soup.

name: Chilli Oil Fried Eggs on Rice
blurb: Crispy-edged eggs, chilli crisp, soy and spring onion over hot rice. Eight minutes.
method: Fry the eggs in hot oil until the edges are lacy and crisp.
Heat the rice and dress with soy, vinegar and half the chilli crisp.
Top with the eggs, more chilli crisp and spring onion.

name: Cold Peanut Noodle Salad
blurb: No-cook once the noodles are done: peanut-lime dressing, cucumber, carrot, herbs.
method: Soak or boil the noodles, then rinse cold.
Whisk the peanut butter with lime, soy, sriracha and a splash of water.
Toss everything together and top with coriander.

name: Ricotta Gnudi, Butter & Sage
blurb: Pillowy ricotta dumplings in nut-brown butter. Deceptively quick, quietly special.
method: Mix the ricotta, Parmesan, yolk and flour to a soft dough, shape into small ovals and dust with flour.
Simmer in salted water 2-3 minutes until they float.
Fry the sage in the butter until it foams and browns, then coat the gnudi.

name: Weeknight Shakshuka
blurb: Eggs poached in a spiced pepper-tomato sauce, straight from the pan with bread.
method: Soften the onion and pepper, add the spices for a minute.
Add the tomatoes and simmer 10 minutes until thick.
Make wells, crack in the eggs, cover and cook until just set. Scatter feta and parsley.

name: Sardine, Lemon & Chilli Spaghetti
blurb: A tin of sardines, garlic, chilli and lemon become a punchy 15-minute pasta.
method: Cook the pasta.
Warm the sardine oil with the garlic and chilli, break in the sardines.
Toss with the pasta, lemon juice, parsley and a spoon of pasta water, then top with the crunchy crumbs.

name: 15-Minute Red Lentil Dhal
blurb: Red lentils, coconut and spice simmered soft while the rice cooks.
method: Simmer the lentils with the coconut milk, water and spices for 15-18 minutes, stirring.
Fry the garlic and ginger and stir through.
Finish with lime juice and serve with rice.

name: Croque Madame
blurb: Ham, cheese and béchamel toasted, crowned with a fried egg. A brisk bit of Paris.
method: Make a quick béchamel with the butter, flour and milk, season and add the mustard.
Build sandwiches with ham and Gruyère, spread the tops with béchamel and more cheese.
Grill until bubbling, then top each with a fried egg.

name: One-Pan Prawn & Tomato Orzo
blurb: Orzo cooked risotto-style with prawns and cherry tomatoes in a single pan.
method: Soften the shallot, add the orzo and toast for a minute.
Add the tomatoes and stock and simmer, stirring, for 10 minutes.
Stir in the prawns for the last 3 minutes, finish with lemon and dill.

name: Speedy Three-Bean Chilli
blurb: A meat-free chilli from tins and spices, done in 25 and better the next day.
method: Soften the onion, stir in the chipotle, cumin and cocoa.
Add the tomatoes and beans and simmer 15 minutes.
Season well and serve over rice.

name: 10-Minute Teriyaki Salmon
blurb: Salmon fillets glazed in a quick teriyaki and grilled sticky. Rice and greens alongside.
method: Simmer the soy, mirin, honey and ginger to a syrup.
Brush over the salmon and grill 6-8 minutes, basting, until glazed.
Serve with rice and steamed tenderstem.

name: Garlic Mushrooms on Sourdough
blurb: Butter-fried mushrooms with garlic, thyme and a splash of cream on toast.
method: Fry the mushrooms in the butter over high heat until deep golden.
Add the garlic and thyme for a minute, then the cream.
Pile onto toasted sourdough.

name: Couscous with Roast Veg & Feta
blurb: Tray-roasted peppers and courgette folded through lemony couscous with feta.
method: Roast the veg with oil at 220C for 20 minutes.
Soak the couscous in an equal volume of boiling water for 5 minutes, then fluff.
Fold in the veg, lemon, mint and crumbled feta.

name: Chicken Katsu Sando
blurb: Crisp panko chicken, tonkatsu sauce and cabbage between soft white bread.
method: Coat the chicken in flour, egg then panko.
Shallow-fry 3-4 minutes each side until golden and cooked through.
Butter the bread, spread with sauce, add cabbage and chicken, press and slice.

name: Sausages with White Bean Mash
blurb: Grilled sausages over a quick garlicky butter-bean mash and greens. Twenty minutes.
method: Grill the sausages until browned all over.
Warm the beans with the garlic and butter, then mash with a splash of milk.
Wilt the spinach through the mash and serve with the sausages.

name: One-Pot Tomato Rice
blurb: Rice cooked straight in a spiced tomato base until fluffy. Minimal effort, maximum comfort.
method: Fry the cumin and onion until soft, add the garam masala.
Stir in the rice, tomatoes and water, bring to a simmer.
Cover and cook 12 minutes, add peas, rest 5 minutes, fluff.

name: Prawn & Avocado Rice Bowl
blurb: Cooked prawns, avocado, cucumber and a soy-sesame drizzle over rice. No cooking bar the rice.
method: Warm or cool the rice as you like and put in a bowl.
Arrange the prawns, avocado and cucumber on top.
Drizzle with soy, sesame oil and sriracha mayo.

name: Fridge-Raid Fried Rice
blurb: Any veg, any protein, cold rice and a hot wok. A different dinner every time.
ingredients: 200g odds and ends of veg, chopped
method: Scramble the eggs and set aside.
Stir-fry the firmer veg, then the softer veg and protein.
Add the rice, fry hard, season with the sauces, fold in the egg and spring onion.

name: Soft Polenta with Mushrooms
blurb: Creamy quick-cook polenta under garlicky mushrooms and Parmesan.
method: Whisk the polenta into the simmering stock and cook 5-8 minutes until thick, then beat in butter and Parmesan.
Fry the mushrooms with garlic and thyme until golden.
Spoon the mushrooms over the polenta.

name: 15-Minute Turkey Burgers
blurb: Quick seasoned turkey patties with a lemon-herb mayo in a bun. Lighter, still juicy.
method: Mix the mince with the onion granules, mustard and seasoning; shape 2 patties.
Fry 4-5 minutes each side until cooked through.
Mix the mayo with lemon and parsley, build the burgers with lettuce and tomato.

name: Cacio e Pepe
blurb: Just pecorino, black pepper and pasta water whipped into a glossy cloak. Purist comfort.
method: Toast the pepper in a wide pan, add a ladle of pasta water.
Cook the pasta until very al dente, move to the pan with more water.
Off the heat, add the pecorino a handful at a time, tossing hard to emulsify.

name: Nduja Butter Beans on Toast
blurb: Butter beans simmered with spicy nduja and tomato, spooned over charred bread.
method: Melt the nduja with the garlic, add the passata and beans.
Simmer 8 minutes until glossy and thick.
Spoon over toasted sourdough and finish with basil.

name: Chicken Larb Lettuce Cups
blurb: Zingy Thai minced chicken with lime, fish sauce, chilli and toasted rice in crisp lettuce.
ingredients: 1 tbsp uncooked rice, toasted and ground
method: Fry the chicken mince until cooked, breaking it up, then take off the heat.
Toss with the fish sauce, lime juice, ground rice, shallots and chilli.
Fold in the herbs and spoon into lettuce leaves.

name: Cheat's Pea & Mint Risotto
blurb: A quick oven-free risotto finished with frozen peas, mint and lemon. Twenty-five minutes.
method: Soften the shallot, add the rice and toast, then add stock a ladle at a time, stirring, for about 18 minutes.
Stir in the peas for the last 3 minutes.
Beat in the butter, Parmesan, mint and lemon and serve loose.

name: Bacon & Kimchi Fried Rice
blurb: Crisp bacon, tangy kimchi and cold rice fried hot, topped with a runny egg.
method: Fry the bacon until crisp, add the kimchi and cook 2 minutes.
Add the rice and gochujang and fry hard for 4 minutes, finish with sesame oil.
Top each bowl with a fried egg and spring onion.

name: Greek Chicken Pita Pockets
blurb: Quick oregano-lemon chicken, tzatziki and tomato stuffed into warm pittas.
method: Toss the chicken with oregano, lemon zest, oil and seasoning and fry 6-8 minutes.
Warm the pittas and open them out.
Fill with tzatziki, chicken, tomato and onion, squeeze over lemon.

name: Spiced Tofu Scramble Wrap
blurb: Turmeric-yellow tofu scramble with peppers and spinach rolled in a tortilla. Vegan, fast.
method: Fry the pepper for 3 minutes, add the tofu, turmeric and paprika.
Cook 5 minutes until dry and golden, then wilt in the spinach.
Pile into tortillas with hot sauce and roll up.

name: Purple Sprouting Broccoli & Anchovy Orecchiette
blurb: Broccoli cooked soft with anchovy, garlic and chilli, clinging to little pasta ears.
method: Boil the pasta, adding the broccoli for the last 4 minutes.
Melt the anchovies in the oil with the garlic and chilli.
Toss the drained pasta and broccoli through, mashing some broccoli into a sauce.
